title.en: Trump to meet Irish leader Micheál Martin during visit
title.zh: 特朗普访问爱尔兰会见领导人

summary.en: Former US President Donald Trump is visiting Dublin for meetings with Irish leaders, including Taoiseach Micheál Martin and President Catherine Connolly. He will also attend the Irish Open golf tournament at his own golf resort in Doonbeg, County Clare.
summary.zh: 美国前总统唐纳德·特朗普正在访问都柏林，与包括总理米歇尔·马丁和总统凯瑟琳·康诺利在内的爱尔兰领导人举行会晤。他还将出席在克莱尔郡多恩贝格他自己的高尔夫度假村举行的爱尔兰公开赛。

body.en:
He was greeted by Tánaiste (Irish deputy prime minister) Simon Harris and Irish Foreign Minister Helen McEntee at Dublin Airport on Saturday morning.

Trump will hold a courtesy call with Irish President Catherine Connolly as well as a bilateral meeting with Taoiseach (Irish Prime Minister) Micheál Martin. He will also attend events at the US Ambassador to Ireland Ed Walsh's residence in Dublin's Phoenix Park.

Trump will then attend the Amgen Irish Open golf tournament which is taking place at the Trump International Golf Links and Hotel Doonbeg in County Clare, which he owns.

Trump is due to meet Irish president Catherine Connolly at the Áras an Uachtaráin.

President Connolly, an outspoken Gaza activist who has been critical of the US and said Trump is acting "like a bully" over tariffs, has come under pressure to raise issues in the Middle East during her brief meeting with the US president.

Sinn Féin and a series of other parties in the Republic who backed her in the Irish presidency campaign last year have called on her to raise Gaza during her meeting with Trump.

Ireland is one of the most pro-Palestinian countries in the European Union and has been criticised for its stance by Israel.

Irish authorities have been planning for Trump's visit for months in what will be one of the biggest security operations in the history of the state.

On Friday night Trump boarded Air Force One at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland, near the US capital Washington DC, and flew out for his trip to Ireland.

He visited the Republic in 2019, when he spent time at his golf course, but he also visited in 2023.

Thousands of people are expected at protests in Dublin and a protest will also be held in Doonbeg.

A small number of crowd control barriers are beside the American Embassy in central Dublin but President Trump is not scheduled to be anywhere near the building.

His sons Eric and Donald Trump Junior are expected to accompany Trump in Doonbeg.

"We will have discussions with the president and there will be a reception in the American Embassy but I think he's also very anxious to get to Doonbeg and watch the Irish Open," Martin told the BBC's Borderlands podcast this week.

"I look forward to welcoming President Trump to Ireland and to discussing the many issues of mutual interest and reaffirming the strong economic, cultural and people-to-people ties between Ireland and the United States."

body.zh: 周六早上，他在都柏林机场受到塔奈斯特（爱尔兰副总理）西蒙·哈里斯和爱尔兰外交部长海伦·麦肯蒂的迎接。 特朗普将与爱尔兰总统凯瑟琳·康诺利进行礼节性拜会，并与爱尔兰总理迈克尔·马丁举行双边会晤。他还将出席美国驻爱尔兰大使埃德·沃尔什位于都柏林凤凰公园的官邸举行的活动。 随后，特朗普将参加在他拥有的克莱尔郡特朗普国际高尔夫球场和敦贝格酒店举行的安进爱尔兰公开赛高尔夫锦标赛。 特朗普将于 Áras an Uachtaráin 会见爱尔兰总统凯瑟琳·康诺利。 康诺利总统是一位直言不讳的加沙活动人士，一直批评美国，并表示特朗普在关税问题上表现得“像一个恶霸”，她在与美国总统的短暂会晤中面临着提出中东问题的压力。 新芬党和去年在爱尔兰总统竞选中支持她的一系列其他共和国政党呼吁她在与特朗普会面时提出加沙问题。 爱尔兰是欧盟最亲巴勒斯坦的国家之一，因其立场而受到以色列的批评。 爱尔兰当局几个月来一直在为特朗普的访问做准备，这将是该国历史上最大规模的安全行动之一。 本文包含 X 提供的内容。在加载任何内容之前，我们会征求您的许可，因为他们可能会使用 cookie 和其他技术。在接受之前，您可能需要阅读 X 的 cookie 政策、外部和隐私政策、外部。要查看此内容，请选择“接受并继续”。 周五晚上，特朗普在美国首都华盛顿特区附近的马里兰州安德鲁斯联合基地登上空军一号，飞往爱尔兰。 他于 2019 年访问了共和国，当时他在自己的高尔夫球场度过了时光，但他也在 2023 年访问过。 预计都柏林将有数千人参加抗议活动，敦贝格也将举行抗议活动。 都柏林市中心的美国大使馆旁边有少量人群控制屏障，但特朗普总统预计不会出现在该建筑附近的任何地方。 他的儿子埃里克·特朗普和小唐纳德·特朗普预计将陪同特朗普前往敦贝格。 “我们将与总统进行讨论，美国大使馆将举行招待会，但我认为他也非常渴望前往敦贝格观看爱尔兰公开赛，”马丁本周在 BBC 的《无主之地》播客中说道。 “我期待着欢迎特朗普总统来到爱尔兰，讨论许多共同关心的问题，并重申爱尔兰与美国之间牢固的经济、文化和民间联系。” “他的访问正值爱尔兰一个非凡的体育夏季，并且......

reflection.en: As leaders meet and discuss matters of state, the call for righteous rule remains paramount. Proverbs 16:12 reminds us that integrity and justice are the foundations of a stable throne, whether in a nation or in any sphere of influence. May leaders seek wisdom and act with fairness.
reflection.zh: 当领导人会晤并讨论国家事务时，追求公义统治的呼召仍然至关重要。《箴言》16:12提醒我们，正直和公正是稳固宝座的基础，无论是在国家还是在任何有影响力的领域。愿领导人寻求智慧，并以公平行事。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

This tension calls to mind the prophet Micah’s call to 'act justly and to love mercy.' May leaders and citizens alike seek wisdom in navigating these complex...
reflection.zh: 随着特朗普总统访问爱尔兰，该国面临着一个微妙的平衡：一方面希望领导人能就争议性政策对当权者说实话，另一方面又要维持经济稳定。这种紧张关系让人想起先知弥迦的呼吁：“只当公义行事，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与你的雅伟同行。”愿领导人和民众在处理这些复杂局面时都能寻求智慧，在他们的决定中兼顾公义与怜悯。

title.en: Grammy-winning US rapper Lil Durk acquitted in murder-for-hire trial
title.zh: 格莱美奖获奖美国说唱歌手Lil Durk在谋杀悬赏案中被判无罪

summary.en: Grammy-winning US rapper Lil Durk was acquitted on Friday of all charges in a federal murder-for-hire case. He was arrested in 2024 and accused of involvement in a shooting that killed the cousin of rival rapper Quando Rondo.
summary.zh: 格莱美奖获奖美国说唱歌手Lil Durk周五在联邦谋杀悬赏案中被判无罪。他于2024年被捕，被指控卷入了一起导致竞争对手说唱歌手Quando Rondo的表亲死亡的枪击案。

body.en:
Grammy-winning rapper Lil Durk was acquitted on Friday of all charges in a federal murder-for-hire case accusing him of orchestrating the revenge killing of a man shot dead in a daytime ambush in Los Angeles four years ago.

The Chicago rapper was arrested in 2024 and accused of involvement in a shooting that killed the cousin of rival rapper Quando Rondo.

Defence lawyer Drew Findling said the recording artist, whose real name is Durk Devontay Banks, was "thankful" following the verdict.

Lil Durk has had seven albums in the US Billboard chart's top five since 2019 and has also collaborated with stars including Drake and J Cole on hit singles.

Supporters cheered outside a Los Angeles courthouse after the verdict, which came following three days of jury deliberations.

The 33-year-old faced five felony counts, including murder for hire resulting in death and conspiracy. If convicted, he could have faced a life sentence.

Although Banks was found not guilty of the charges in the case, he remains in custody and faces a separate trial on 5 October, where he will face racketeering murder and firearms charges.

"While we are disappointed with the jury's decision regarding Durk Banks, a.k.a. 'Lil Durk,' we look forward to presenting our evidence at his second trial", First Assistant US Attorney Bill Essayli said in a statement.

In the three-week trial, two co-defendants were tried alongside Banks. Deandre "OTF Dede" Wilson and David "Browneyez" Lindsey were convicted of stalking and conspiracy to commit stalking, but acquitted of murder-for-hire charges, the BBC's US partner CBS News reports , external .

The trial relied on three co-operating witnesses, Kavon "OTF Vonnie" Grant, Keith "Flacka" Jones and Kacey "OTF Jam" Hester, who reached plea deals and testified against Banks, Wilson and Lindsey.

It stemmed from a fatal shooting in August 2022 at a petrol station in Los Angeles, where a car carrying Rondo, whose real name is Tyquian Bowman, was shot at. Bowman was unharmed, but his cousin Saviay'a Robinson, who was also in the car, was killed.

Federal prosecutors accused Banks of plotting to kill Bowman, in retaliation for the earlier murder of Chicago OTF rapper King Von, who was signed to OTF. Von was killed in 2020 during an early-morning exchange of gunfire in Atlanta.

A friend of Bowman was charged with King Von's murder, but the charges were later dropped. Bowman was not arrested or charged.

Authorities said Banks made it known that he would "pay a bounty" to anyone who killed Bowman. Prosecutors argued that Banks felt pressure on social media to avenge Von's death.

Banks founded OTF in 2010. He won the 2024 Grammy Award for Best Melodic Rap Performance for his single "All My Life" featuring J Cole. He has also been nominated for a Grammy...
body.zh: 周五，格莱美奖得主说唱歌手利尔·杜克 (Lil Durk) 在联邦雇佣谋杀案中的所有指控被宣告无罪，该案指控他策划报复杀害四年前在洛杉矶白天伏击中被枪杀的一名男子。 这位芝加哥说唱歌手于 2024 年被捕，被指控参与枪击案，导致竞争对手说唱歌手 Quando Rondo 的表弟身亡。 辩护律师德鲁·芬德林 (Drew Findling) 表示，这位真名是杜尔克·德文泰·班克斯 (Durk Devontay Banks) 的唱片艺术家在判决后表示“感激”。 自 2019 年以来，Lil Durk 已有 7 张专辑跻身美国公告牌排行榜前五名，还与 Drake 和 J Cole 等明星合作制作了热门单曲。 经过三天的陪审团审议后，判决结果公布后，支持者在洛杉矶法院外欢呼雀跃。 这名 33 岁的男子面临五项重罪指控，包括雇佣谋杀导致死亡和共谋。如果罪名成立，他可能面临无期徒刑。 尽管班克斯被判无罪，但他仍被拘留，并于 10 月 5 日面临单独审判，他将面临敲诈勒索谋杀和枪支指控。 美国第一助理检察官 Bill Essayli 在一份声明中表示：“虽然我们对陪审团对杜尔克·班克斯（又名‘Lil Durk’）的决定感到失望，但我们期待在他的第二次审判中提供我们的证据。” 在为期三周的审判中，两名共同被告与班克斯一起受审。据英国广播公司美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，德安德烈·“OTF·德德”·威尔逊和大卫·“布劳尼兹”·林赛被判犯有跟踪和串谋跟踪罪，但被判无罪释放雇佣谋杀罪。 审判依赖于三名合作证人，即 Kavon“OTF Vonnie”Grant、Keith“Flacka”Jones 和 Kacey“OTF Jam”Hester，他们达成认罪协议并出庭指控 Banks、Wilson 和 Lindsey。 此事源于 2022 年 8 月在洛杉矶一家加油站发生的致命枪击事件，一辆载有隆多（真名泰奎安·鲍曼）的汽车被枪击。鲍曼没有受伤，但他的表弟萨维亚·罗宾逊（Saviay'a Robinson）也在车里，但他被杀了。 联邦检察官指控班克斯密谋杀害鲍曼，以报复早些时候被谋杀的 OTF 签约歌手 King Von。 2020 年，冯在亚特兰大清晨的交火中丧生。 鲍曼的一位朋友被指控谋杀冯国王，但指控后来被撤销。鲍曼没有被捕或受到指控。 当局表示，班克斯公开表示，他将向任何杀害鲍曼的人“支付赏金”。检察官辩称，班克斯在社交媒体上感受到了为冯报仇的压力。 班克斯于 2010 年创立了 OTF。他凭借与 J Cole 合作的单曲《All My Life》获得了 2024 年格莱美最佳旋律说唱表演奖。他还获得了格莱美奖提名...

reflection.en: The acquittal of rapper Lil Durk in a murder-for-hire case highlights the destructive cycles of violence and revenge that can ensnare individuals and communities. Jesus' words, "Put your sword back in its place... for all who draw the sword will die by the sword," serve as a timeless warning against escalating conflict and the inevitable consequences of...
reflection.zh: 说唱歌手Lil Durk在谋杀悬赏案中被判无罪，这凸显了可能使个人和社区陷入困境的暴力和复仇的破坏性循环。耶稣所说的话：“收刀入鞘吧。凡动刀的，必死在刀下”，是对升级冲突和暴力不可避免的后果发出的永恒警告。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: Australians love traveling to the UK. They could soon be paying more
title.zh: 英国人喜爱前往英国旅行。他们可能很快就要支付更多费用了

summary.en: The UK government is moving ahead with a controversial levy, the 'Overnight Visitor Levy,' which will allow regional mayors to charge a percentage on accommodation stays. Prime Minister Andy Burnham hopes this tax will help shift power and money away from London, with the 1.2 million Australians who visit the UK...
summary.zh: 英国政府正着手实施一项有争议的收费项目——“过夜游客税”，该项目将允许地区市长按比例收取住宿费用。安迪·伯纳姆首相希望这项税收能帮助将权力和资金从伦敦转移出去，每年访问英国的120万澳大利亚游客可能会面临更高的费用。

body.en:
The bill is about to get steeper for the 1.2 million Australians who travel to the UK every year as British mayors will soon have the power to charge a so-called "tourist tax" on accommodation.

Last week the UK government announced it was going to be pressing ahead with the controversial levy which Prime Minister Andy Burnham — the so called "King of the North" — hopes will help move power and money way from London.

Called the "Overnight Visitor Levy," it gives regional mayors the option to tax people on a percentage of their stays at hotels, bed and breakfasts and other types of accommodation.

Burnham— who replaced Keir Starmer as prime minister in July— sees the levy as a way of financially empowering regional cities.

He said last week the tax would come into force towards the end of the next financial year, with mayors expected to set out spending plans for the funds raised by early 2028.

The levy will be set at the discretion of city councils but on Friday Labour mayors in 10 regional cities said they would cap the charge the charge at five per cent, following widespread concerns from the hospitality industry that the levy would dampen spending.

An exact date for the levy's introduction has not been announced but Burnham said the tax would come into force towards the end of next financial year and apply to both Britons and international tourists.

The exact terms of the levy could vary from city to city, but mayors in London, Greater Manchester, Liverpool City Region, West Midlands, North East, West of England, West Yorkshire, South Yorkshire, East Midlands and York and North Yorkshire have all agreed to the five per cent cap.

Two Reform UK mayors and two Conservative party mayors have said they would oppose any levy — so its possible the price of accommodation will go up in some cities, but not others.

While the five per cent levy would be new for regional cities in Britain, it's not a UK first.

In July, Edinburgh launched a 5 per cent levy on accommodation that's capped at five nights and similar taxes are already common around the world.

New York, LA, Brussels, Amsterdam, Toronto and Montreal all have their own equivalent charges.

Wales is set to introduce it's own £1.30 per person per night levy in April of next year.

The move has not been supported by UKHospitality, which represents the sector. It said the move would hurt British families and add to red tape.

"Give mayors one tax-raising power on one sector and they will pull that lever until it snaps," said Chief Executive Allen Simpson.

body.zh: 由于英国市长很快将有权对住宿征收所谓的“旅游税”，因此每年前往英国旅游的 120 万澳大利亚人的账单将变得更加昂贵。 上周，英国政府宣布将推进有争议的征税，被称为“北方之王”的首相安迪·伯纳姆希望此举有助于将权力和金钱从伦敦转移出去。 它被称为“过夜游客税”，它让地区市长可以选择对人们在酒店、住宿加早餐和其他类型住宿的住宿比例征税。 伯纳姆于 7 月接替凯尔·斯塔默 (Keir Starmer) 出任总理，他认为征税是增强地区城市财政实力的一种方式。 他上周表示，该税收将在下一个财政年度结束时生效，预计市长们将制定 2028 年初筹集资金的支出计划。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 征税将由市议会自行决定，但周五，10 个地区城市的工党市长表示，由于酒店业普遍担心征税会抑制支出，他们将把收费上限限制在 5%。 征收该税的具体日期尚未公布，但伯纳姆表示，该税将于下财年末生效，适用于英国人和国际游客。 征税的具体条款可能因城市而异，但伦敦、大曼彻斯特、利物浦城市地区、西米德兰兹、东北部、英格兰西部、西约克郡、南约克郡、东米德兰兹以及约克和北约克郡的市长都同意5%的上限。 两位英国改革派市长和两位保守党市长表示，他们反对任何征税——因此，一些城市的住宿价格可能会上涨，但其他城市则不会。 虽然百分之五的征税对于英国地区城市来说是新举措，但这并不是英国首创。 7月，爱丁堡对住宿征收5%的税，上限为五晚，类似的税收在世界各地已经很常见。 纽约、洛杉矶、布鲁塞尔、阿姆斯特丹、多伦多和蒙特利尔都有各自的同等费用。 威尔士将于明年 4 月推出每人每晚 1.30 英镑的税收。 此举并未得到代表该行业的英国酒店业协会的支持。它表示此举将伤害英国家庭并增加繁文缛节。 首席执行官艾伦·辛普森 (Allen Simpson) 表示：“赋予市长对某个行业增税的权力，他们就会拉动杠杆，直到杠杆断裂为止。” 辛普森引用了牛津经济咨询公司的研究估计……

reflection.en: The proposal for an 'Overnight Visitor Levy' in the UK highlights how local leaders seek to fund public services and regional development. Jeremiah 22:3 reminds us that rulers are called to 'execute justice and righteousness' and 'deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence.' This principle calls leaders to consider the impact of their...
reflection.zh: 英国提议征收“过夜游客税”，这凸显了地方领导人如何寻求为公共服务和区域发展提供资金。《耶利米书》22章3节提醒我们，统治者被呼召要“施行公平和公义”，并“从欺压者的手中拯救那受欺压的”。这一原则呼吁领导人考虑其财政决策对所有人的影响，确保政策服务于共同利益，并且不会给游客或居民带来不当负担。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

The immense financial donation to a political party raises questions about the influence of money in politics and the ethical considerations surrounding such large sums, especially when linked to past financial improprieties. verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.

title.en: AI may be denting computer science graduates’ job prospects, UK data shows
title.zh: 人工智能可能正在削弱计算机科学毕业生的就业前景，英国数据显示

summary.en: Data from the UK suggests that artificial intelligence may be negatively impacting job prospects for recent graduates in computer science and economics. Occupations like coding and software development saw the fastest decline in demand for graduates last year, and employer demand for economics graduates in well-paid...
summary.zh: 英国的数据表明，人工智能可能正在对计算机科学和经济学专业毕业生的就业前景产生负面影响。去年，编码和软件开发等职业的毕业生需求下降速度最快，雇主对经济学专业毕业生在薪酬丰厚的金融领域的需求也有所下降。

body.en: Economics graduates also appear to be affected as demand for them falls in well-paid roles in finance AI may be warping the job prospects for students in the previously high-demand subjects of computer science and economics, according to a detailed look into the careers of recent UK graduates. Data obtained for the 2027 Guardian University Guide published on Saturday shows that coding and software development were the fastest-falling occupations for graduates last year, while employer demand for graduates in well-paid roles in financial categories such as economists and management consultants also declined. Continue reading...

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.

title.en: Russia's drone war comes to Moldova and Romania
title.zh: 俄罗斯的无人机战争蔓延至摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚

summary.en: Russian drone incursions into Moldovan and Romanian airspace are becoming more frequent. This week, the Ukrainian president's plane was prevented from taking off from Chisinau. Observers suspect these incursions are deliberate, extending the air war's reach beyond Ukraine's borders.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯无人机侵入摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚领空的情况日益频繁。本周，乌克兰总统的飞机被阻止从基希讷乌起飞。观察家怀疑这些侵入是故意的，将空战的范围扩大到了乌克兰境外。

body.en:
Incursions by Russian drones into Moldovan and Romanian airspace are increasingly common. This week the Ukrainian president's plane was stopped from taking off from Chisinau. Observers suspect the attacks are deliberate.

For Ukrainians, Russia's air war has been a bitter, bloody reality for years. People in Ukraine are being  killed every day by missiles, bombs, and drones . But the country's central and southeastern European neighbors have also found themselves affected, albeit on a smaller scale: Missiles and drones sometimes invade their air space, and occasionally even crash on their territory.

Now the Russian drone war is coming dangerously close to two of Ukraine's neighbors: Romania and the Republic of Moldova , where drone incidents are now an almost daily occurrence. The drones often explode, leaving people injured, and there have also been recent attacks on Ukrainian checkpoints at the Moldovan and Romanian borders.

The attacks have now escalated to such a degree that many observers believe they can no longer be considered unintentional. They suspect the Kremlin is deliberately trying to bring the war to Ukraine's neighbors.

The latest drone incursion and crash on Tuesday caused a furore as it prevented a plane with the Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on board from taking off in the Moldovan capital Chisinau. A Russian Geran drone, which can fly as fast as 500 kilometers per hour (311 mph), took off in Crimea, then flew through Ukrainian airspace and eventually crashed in a sunflower field near the Moldovan city of Riscani.

The drone also flew over Romania, where two fighter jets were scrambled from NATO's Kogalniceanu airbase near the Black Sea port of Constanta, though it remains unclear why they did not shoot down the drone, as they had on other occasions.

The most serious aspect of the incident was that it showed how limited Moldovan air defense is in its ability to protect the country's air space. The drones were detected and tracked by air traffic control, but it was not possible to shoot them down. According to publicly available information, the country possesses only a small number of Polish Piorun anti-aircraft missiles, and these are only able to protect certain specific targets.

There have been around three dozen drone incidents in Romania and Moldova since the beginning of August this year. The majority were airspace violations, but there have also been crashes and explosions, while debris has also been found. In Romania, several drones have also been shot down. According to official data, 17 drones crashed in August in Moldova alone – as many as in all of 2025.

There was also a drone strike on the Starokozache border crossing between Ukraine and southeastern...
body.zh: 俄罗斯无人机入侵摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚领空的情况越来越普遍。本周，乌克兰总统的专机被阻止从基希讷乌起飞。观察人士怀疑这些袭击是故意的。 对于乌克兰人来说，俄罗斯的空战多年来一直是痛苦而血腥的现实。乌克兰每天都有人被导弹、炸弹和无人机杀害。但该国的中欧和东南欧邻国也发现自己受到了影响，尽管规模较小：导弹和无人机有时会侵入其领空，有时甚至坠毁在其领土上。 现在，俄罗斯无人机战争正危险地逼近乌克兰的两个邻国：罗马尼亚和摩尔多瓦共和国，这两个国家几乎每天都会发生无人机事件。无人机经常爆炸，造成人员受伤，最近摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚边境的乌克兰检查站也发生了袭击事件。 现在，袭击已经升级到了如此程度，以至于许多观察家认为这些袭击不能再被认为是无意的。他们怀疑克里姆林宫故意试图将战争带到乌克兰的邻国。 周二最新的无人机入侵和坠机事件引起了轩然大波，因为它阻止了载有乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基的一架飞机在摩尔多瓦首都基希讷乌起飞。一架俄罗斯Geran无人机的飞行速度可达每小时500公里（311英里/小时），从克里米亚起飞，然后飞越乌克兰领空，最终坠毁在摩尔多瓦城市里斯卡尼附近的向日葵田里。 这架无人机还飞越了罗马尼亚上空，两架战斗机从黑海康斯坦察港附近的北约科加尔尼恰努空军基地起飞，不过目前还不清楚为什么他们没有像其他场合那样击落这架无人机。 该事件最严重的方面是，它表明摩尔多瓦防空部队保护该国领空的能力是多么有限。空中交通管制发现并跟踪了这些无人机，但无法将其击落。根据公开信息，波兰仅拥有少量皮奥伦防空导弹，且只能保护某些特定目标。 自今年八月初以来，罗马尼亚和摩尔多瓦已发生约三打无人机事件。大多数都是侵犯领空的事件，但也发生过坠机和爆炸事件，同时也发现了碎片。 在罗马尼亚，也有几架无人机被击落。根据官方数据，8 月份仅摩尔多瓦就有 17 架无人机坠毁，这一数字是 2025 年全年的总数量。 乌克兰和东南部之间的斯塔科扎切边境口岸也遭到无人机袭击。

reflection.en: The escalating use of drones in neighboring countries' airspace, extending the conflict's reach beyond Ukraine, echoes the dangerous cycle of retaliation. Romans 12:21 calls us to resist the urge to mirror aggression with aggression, urging instead to overcome evil with good. This principle challenges nations and individuals alike to seek paths of...
reflection.zh: 无人机在邻国领空的使用日益升级，将冲突的范围扩大到乌克兰之外，这呼应了危险的报复循环。罗马书12:21呼吁我们抵制以侵略回应侵略的冲动，而要以善胜恶。这一原则挑战国家和个人，即使面对挑衅，也要寻求缓和局势与和平的道路。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Thousands of ebikes seized by London councils as anger rises over blocked paths
title.zh: 伦敦议会扣押数千辆电动自行车，引发不满

summary.en: London boroughs have seized over 3,000 e-bikes this year due to hazardous parking and abandonment, a 23% increase from the previous year. Hire companies are facing pressure to manage their fleets better, while councils lament the lack of central regulation.
summary.zh: 据《卫报》调查，伦敦各区今年已扣押超过3000辆电动自行车，原因是停放危险或被遗弃，比去年同期增长了23%。租赁公司面临着更大的压力来更好地管理其车队，而市政当局则抱怨缺乏中央监管。

body.en: Operators blame lack of parking and councils bemoan lack of central regulation, as more than 3,000 badly parked bikes seized London boroughs have seized at least 3,000 ebikes this year, a Guardian investigation has found, as hire companies face growing calls to stop bicycles littering streets and blocking pavements. Local authorities across the capital have seized 3,393 hazardously parked or abandoned ebikes so far this year, 23% higher than the number seized during all of 2025. Continue reading...
body.zh: 卫报的一项调查发现，运营商将原因归咎于缺乏停车位，而议会则抱怨缺乏中央监管，伦敦各行政区今年查获了 3,000 多辆停放不当的自行车，至少查获了 3,000 辆电动自行车，租赁公司面临越来越多的呼吁，要求停止自行车在街道上乱扔和堵塞人行道。今年迄今为止，首都各地当局已查获 3,393 辆危险停放或废弃的电动自行车，比 2025 年全年查获的数量高出 23%。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sight of thousands of e-bikes seized by London councils speaks to a breakdown in shared public space. When regulations are unclear or unenforced, the convenience for some can become a hazard and obstruction for many. This situation calls for leaders to ensure that systems serve the common good, practicing justice and righteousness in managing the city's...
reflection.zh: 伦敦各区扣押数千辆电动自行车的景象，反映了公共空间的共享秩序出现了混乱。当法规不明确或执行不力时，一些人的便利可能成为许多人的危险和障碍。这种情况呼吁领导者确保制度服务于公共利益，在管理城市基础设施时践行公义和正直。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: How Trump used 9/11 to make the case for war with Iran
title.zh: 特朗普如何利用9/11来为对伊朗开战辩护

summary.en: President Donald Trump used a 9/11 memorial ceremony at the Pentagon to link the "War on Terror" to the ongoing US-Israeli conflict with Iran, while also touching on election conspiracy theories and a controversial midterm proposal, as his approval ratings remain low two months before elections.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统在五角大楼的9/11纪念仪式上，将“反恐战争”与正在进行的美国-以色列与伊朗的冲突联系起来，同时还触及了选举阴谋论和一个有争议的中期选举提案，因为他在选举前两个月支持率依然低迷。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump has used a memorial ceremony marking the 25th anniversary of 9/11 to draw a direct line between the "War on Terror" that followed the terrorist attacks and the on-going US-Israeli war on Iran.

In an unusual move, Trump paid his respects at the Pentagon rather than attending the main ceremony in New York, where two hijacked planes struck the Twin Towers at the World Trade Centre in a series of attacks that killed 2,977 people September 11, 2001.

He used the same event to also touch on election conspiracy claims and a controversial midterm proposal, as Trump's approval rating sits near historic lows just two months out from the elections.

In his Pentagon address, Trump drew parallels between the September 11 attack and the US' deeply unpopular war in Iran.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Today we renew the sacred oath that we first swore in their names a quarter of a century ago. We will never, ever forget," Trump said. "That’s why we fight today."

"We don’t have a choice. There can only be victory. We fight hard. We fight to win."

He drew links between the fight against Al-Qaeda — launched by his Republican predecessor George W. Bush after the attacks — and the ongoing US-Israeli war against Iran, now in its seventh month.

"Today we salute every member of the United States military who served in the 'war on terror'," he said.

"And we salute the service members working right now to ensure the world’s number one sponsor of terror, the Islamic Republic of Iran, will never ever have a nuclear weapon."

US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth used his own remarks at the ceremony to boast about the US' success in the war.

"Over the past six months, we have laid waste to the world's most prolific state sponsor of terrorism. Our warriors have fought an Islamic theocracy that has wished us death for nearly half a century," Hegseth said.

“We’re still sending terrorists where they belong, to hell, and tankers to the bottom of the ocean where they belong. And we’re ensuring that Iran will never have a nuclear weapon."

Hegseth claimed the US had destroyed Iran's defences and controlled the Strait of Hormuz, adding that "economic pressure tightens every day" and the US "will finish this fight".

The Iran war has slid into a stalemate with Iran largely maintaining its grip on the Strait of Hormuz, and keeping oil prices high, despite sporadic exchanges of fire with the US.

Trump also used his speech to take aim at domestic political opponents, calling them "fanatics".

title.en: Ukraine faces 'toughest winter' since Russia's full-scale invasion, UN official tells BBC
title.zh: 联合国官员告诉BBC：乌克兰正面临俄罗斯全面入侵以来最艰难的冬天

summary.en: A senior UN official has warned the BBC that Ukraine is facing its most difficult winter since the full-scale Russian invasion in 2022, with a risk of "humanitarian catastrophe" if attacks disrupt power and water supplies.
summary.zh: 一位联合国高级官员告诉BBC，乌克兰正面临自2022年俄罗斯全面入侵以来最艰难的冬天，如果俄罗斯的袭击切断电力和供水，存在“人道主义灾难”的风险。

body.en:
Ukraine is facing its "toughest winter" since Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022, a top United Nations official told the BBC.

Alexander De Croo, head of the UN development agency, said there was a risk of "humanitarian catastrophe" if Russian attacks cut off access to power and water.

Speaking in Ukraine, De Croo – the UN's third most senior official – accused Russia of systematically targeting the country's energy infrastructure. He said there was now a "race against the clock" to repair the power network before winter sets in and temperatures plummet.

Russia and Ukraine have been intensifying aerial attacks in recent months, and both deny deliberately targeting civilian infrastructure.

Russia has started to use faster, jet-powered drones that are harder to intercept in recent around-the-clock attacks on Ukraine - and in particular Kyiv. Many of the strikes have targeted Ukraine's infrastructure, including businesses, warehouses, factories, petrol stations, as well as energy infrastructure.

Ukraine continues to launch drone strikes deep into Russian territory, largely against gas, oil and business distribution facilities. Both countries deny targeting civilians.

Deadly attacks have resumed after US President Donald Trump sent envoys for talks in Moscow with Russian President Vladimir Putin and in Kyiv with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky last weekend.

Five people were killed and 67 others were wounded in a daytime Russian drone strike on a shopping mall in Pavlohrad, a city in Dnipropetrovsk region, on Thursday, Ukrainian officials say. Earlier in the week two other shopping malls were targeted by Russian air strikes, killing two people and injuring 28 people in the attacks on the cities of Zaporizhzhia and Sumy.

Russia reported a Ukrainian seaborne drone attack on the resort city of Sochi overnight on Wednesday, in which 28 people were wounded, as well as three more deaths blamed on Ukrainian attacks.

Two people were also killed earlier this week when Russian drones hit a border crossing between Ukraine and Moldova, which has increasingly found itself caught up in the conflict.

A full-scale war has been raging between Russia and Ukraine since Putin launched an invasion more than four and a half years ago.

De Croo, a former prime minister of Belgium, told the BBC: "This winter is going to be the toughest one since the war".

He said Ukraine started "from a very weak base going into this winter". He added the UN were "very, very worried... about what this winter could become."

The concerns are driven by what De Croo said was Russia's "very systematic" targeting of civilian and energy infrastructure.

body.zh: 一位联合国高级官员告诉 BBC，乌克兰正面临自 2022 年俄罗斯全面入侵以来“最艰难的冬天”。 联合国发展机构负责人亚历山大·德克罗表示，如果俄罗斯的袭击切断了电力和水源，就有可能发生“人道主义灾难”。 联合国第三位高级官员德克罗在乌克兰发表讲话，指责俄罗斯系统性地针对该国的能源基础设施。他说，现在正在“与时间赛跑”，以在冬季到来和气温骤降之前修复电网。 俄罗斯和乌克兰近几个月来不断加强空袭，两国都否认蓄意针对民用基础设施。 俄罗斯已开始使用速度更快的喷气式无人机，这些无人机在最近对乌克兰（尤其是基辅）的全天候袭击中更难拦截。许多袭击都针对乌克兰的基础设施，包括企业、仓库、工厂、加油站以及能源基础设施。 乌克兰继续对俄罗斯领土深处发动无人机袭击，主要针对天然气、石油和商业配送设施。两国均否认以平民为目标。 上周末，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普派特使在莫斯科与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京以及在基辅与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基举行会谈后，致命袭击又重新开始。 乌克兰官员称，周四白天，俄罗斯无人机对第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克地区巴甫洛赫拉德的一家购物中心发动袭击，造成 5 人死亡、67 人受伤。本周早些时候，另外两家购物中心成为俄罗斯空袭的目标，扎波罗热市和苏梅市的袭击造成 2 人死亡、28 人受伤。 俄罗斯报道称，周三夜间，乌克兰海上无人机袭击了度假城市索契，造成 28 人受伤，另有 3 人因乌克兰袭击而死亡。 本周早些时候，俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰和摩尔多瓦之间的过境点，造成两人死亡，摩尔多瓦越来越多地陷入冲突。 自四年半前普京发动入侵以来，俄罗斯和乌克兰之间一直在爆发全面战争。 比利时前首相德克罗告诉英国广播公司：“今年冬天将是战后最艰难的冬天”。 他说，乌克兰“从一个非常薄弱的​​基础进入今年冬天”。他补充说，联合国“非常非常担心……今年冬天会发生什么”。 德克罗表示，俄罗斯“非常系统地”针对民用和能源基础设施进行攻击，引发了人们的担忧。 “这是加油站、购物中心、商业中心，但尤其是能源基础设施、能源......

The UN official's warning of a potential humanitarian catastrophe highlights the vulnerability of civilians caught in the crossfire. title.en: DW exclusive: Zelenskyy offers to meet Putin at G20 in Miami
title.zh: 泽连斯基：若普京出席G20，愿赴迈阿密会晤

summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated in a DW interview that Ukraine is in a strong negotiating position and offered to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin at the upcoming G20 summit in Miami, should Putin attend.
summary.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在接受德国之声（DW）采访时表示，乌克兰处于有利的谈判地位，并提议如果俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京出席即将举行的G20峰会，他愿意前往迈阿密与普京会晤。

body.en:
In an interview with DW, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said his country was in a strong position to negotiate and offered to meet Vladimir Putin in Miami.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said he would travel to Miami if his Russian counterpart, Vladimir Putin, attended the Group of 20 (G20) leaders' summit scheduled for December.

Zelenskyy replied enthusiastically when DW's correspondent Misha Komadovsky posed the question on Friday.

"Yes, of course. We have to come. We have to meet, to speak and make decisions," he said.

Zelenskyy added that what he was going to say to Putin mattered less than results.

"It's not about words. What I will tell him or what he wants to tell me, it doesn’t matter. It doesn’t matter. [...] Results matter. That's it."

Zelenskyy and Putin have not met in person since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of its smaller neighbor in February 2022.

The Kremlin has so far declined to say whether Putin would go to Miami for the meeting.

The Russian leader has not personally attended a G20 summit since 2019.

Last month, Russia's Finance Minister Anton Siluanov was however invited by the US to attend a meeting of G20 countries in North Carolina in a move that upset European officials.

First up, however, Zelenskyy spoke of the deals he signed on Thursday with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, including a 100-year partnership declaration.

Zelenskyy underlined the importance of the deal, which he said covered numerous sectors, "from security, financing, energy, very important energy, veteran policy, and culture, and relationships and humanitarian issues." 

"So it's a global decision, a really historic decision, and I'm happy that we have it," he said.

Zelenskyy said he had also signed a deal on collaboration on drone production with the Canadian leader involving a number of Ukrainian companies.   

Zelenskyy's interview with DW comes as summer is nearly over and Ukraine is gearing up for the cold months of winter.

The Ukrainian president has conceded that his country has been struggling to counter flying jet-propelled drones that Russia has been increasingly deploying.

"They [US] have political will to sell and to help, but the production is not too big. So it means that stocks is a variant," he said.

Patriot missiles are powerful weapons that are currently the most effective defense against Russian ballistic missile attacks.

"Russia [currently] produces 140 ballistic missiles per month. So, according to the rules of NATO, if you want to destroy 140, you need a 1-to-2 [ratio], 280 missiles," Zelenskyy told DW.

"You will never have 280 missiles per month, and between us, it’s a huge challenge to have...
body.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基在接受德国之声采访时表示，乌克兰在谈判中处于有利地位，并提出在迈阿密与普京会面。 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，如果俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京出席定于 12 月举行的 20 国集团 (G20) 领导人峰会，他将前往迈阿密。 当德国之声记者米沙·科马多夫斯基周五提出这个问题时，泽伦斯基热情地回答了。 “是的，当然。我们必须来。我们必须会面、发言并做出决定，”他说。 泽连斯基补充说，他要对普京说的话并不重要，结果更重要。 “这与言语无关。我会告诉他什么或他想告诉我什么，这并不重要。这并不重要。[...]结果很重要。就是这样。” 自俄罗斯于 2022 年 2 月对其较小邻国发动全面入侵以来，泽伦斯基和普京尚未见过面。 克里姆林宫迄今拒绝透露普京是否会前往迈阿密参加会议。 自 2019 年以来，这位俄罗斯领导人就没有亲自出席过 G20 峰会。 然而上个月，俄罗斯财政部长安东·西卢阿诺夫应美国邀请参加在北卡罗来纳州举行的二十国集团 (G20) 国家会议，此举令欧洲官员感到不安。 不过，泽连斯基首先谈到了他周四与加拿大总理马克·卡尼签署的协议，其中包括一份 100 年合作伙伴关系宣言。 泽伦斯基强调了该协议的重要性，他说该协议涵盖了众多领域，“从安全、融资、能源、非常重要的能源、退伍军人政策、文化、关系和人道主义问题”。 “所以这是一个全球性的决定，一个真正的历史性决定，我很高兴我们做出了这个决定，”他说。 泽伦斯基表示，他还与加拿大领导人签署了一项涉及多家乌克兰公司的无人机生产合作协议。 泽连斯基接受德国之声采访之际，夏季即将结束，乌克兰正在为寒冷的冬季做准备。 乌克兰总统承认，乌克兰一直在努力对抗俄罗斯越来越多地部署的喷气式无人机。 “他们（美国）有出售和提供帮助的政治意愿，但产量不太大。所以这意味着库存是一种变体，”他说。 爱国者导弹是目前最有效防御俄罗斯弹道导弹攻击的强大武器。 “俄罗斯（目前）每月生产140枚弹道导弹。因此，根据北约的规则，如果你想摧毁140枚，就需要1比2的[比例]，即280枚导弹，”泽连斯基告诉德国之声。 “你永远不可能每月拥有 280 枚导弹，对我们来说，这是一个巨大的挑战......

reflection.en: In the midst of ongoing conflict, President Zelenskyy's willingness to meet with President Putin at the G20 summit in Miami signals a commitment to dialogue. This echoes Jesus's teaching to be peacemakers, who will be called children of God, emphasizing the active pursuit of reconciliation even in adversarial circumstances.
reflection.zh: 在持续的冲突中，泽连斯基总统表示愿意在G20峰会上与普京总统会晤，这标志着对对话的承诺。这呼应了耶稣关于成为和平之子教导，强调即使在敌对的情况下也要积极寻求和解。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.

title.en: The North Korean missile launch that South Korea is closely monitoring
title.zh: 韩国密切关注朝鲜导弹发射

summary.en: North Korea launched several short-range ballistic missiles early Saturday morning, which flew approximately 250km before landing in the ocean off its east coast. South Korean and US authorities are analyzing the missile specifications, and information was shared with Japan.
summary.zh: 朝鲜于周六清晨发射了数枚短程弹道导弹，飞行约250公里后落在其东海岸外的海域。韩国和美国当局正在分析导弹的规格，并已与日本分享了相关信息。

body.en:
North Korea fired several short-range ballistic missiles from the Wonsan area toward the sea off its east coast, South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) said on Saturday.

The missiles were launched from around 5.20am (6.20am AEST) and flew about 250km, the JCS said in a statement, adding that South Korean and US authorities were conducting a detailed analysis of their specifications.

South Korean and US intelligence authorities had tracked and shared information on the launches from the outset, while information on the ballistic missiles was also shared with Japan, the JCS said.

"South Korea's military is closely monitoring North Korean activity and maintaining the capability and readiness to respond overwhelmingly to any provocation under its combined defence posture with the United States," the JCS said in a statement.

South Korea's presidential National Security Office convened an emergency security meeting involving the defence ministry, the JCS and other relevant agencies following the launch, the presidential office said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Officials reviewed the government's response, assessed the impact of the launches on South Korea's security and examined necessary measures, the presidential office said. It urged North Korea to immediately stop ballistic missile launches, calling them a serious violation of UN Security Council resolutions.

Separately, US Pacific Command said it was aware of the launches and was consulting closely with allies and partners. It said the launches, based on its current assessment, did not pose an immediate threat to US personnel, territory or allies.

"The United States remains committed to the defense of the US homeland and our allies in the region," it said in a post on X.

Last month, North Korea launched more than 10 short-range ballistic missiles and ordered its military to maintain full readiness during South Korea's ongoing joint exercises with the United States.

Saturday's launch came a day after South Korea, Japan and the .S concluded their joint military drills to test readiness against North Korea's missile and nuclear weapons threats.

Separately last month, US President Donald Trump abruptly scaled back military drills, which he described as hostile to North Korea, and said he expected to meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un late this year.

title.en: Saudi Arabia shuts down oil pipeline, blaming drones from Iraq
title.zh: 沙特阿拉伯因无人机袭击关闭石油管道，指责来自伊拉克

summary.en: Saudi Arabia has temporarily closed its East-West oil pipeline after drone attacks, which authorities stated originated from Iraq. The pipeline is crucial for exporting oil and has been increasingly used to bypass the Strait of Hormuz, which has faced closures amid regional conflict.
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯因无人机袭击而暂时关闭了东西输油管道，当局称袭击来自伊拉克。该管道对石油出口至关重要，并且由于地区冲突导致霍尔木兹海峡关闭，该管道的使用日益增多。

body.en: Riyadh has increased its use of the East-West pipeline since the start of the Middle East war to bypass the closure of the strait of Hormuz Saudi authorities said Friday drones launched from Iraq led to the temporary closure of a crucial oil export route used to bypass the lockdown of the strait of Hormuz . Riyadh has increased its use of the East-West pipeline, which links Abqaiq, near the Gulf, to the port of Yanbu on the Red Sea, since the start of the Middle East war to bypass strait of Hormuz closed by Iran. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自中东战争爆发以来，利雅得增加了对东西方管道的使用，以绕过霍尔木兹海峡的封锁。 沙特当局周五表示，从伊拉克发射的无人机导致一条用于绕过霍尔木兹海峡封锁的重要石油出口路线暂时关闭。自中东战争爆发以来，利雅得增加了对连接海湾附近的布盖克和红海延布港的东西管道的使用，以绕过伊朗关闭的霍尔木兹海峡。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The drone attack on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, launched from Iraq, illustrates the destructive cycle of conflict. In such moments, the temptation is to respond with further aggression. Yet, Scripture calls us to a higher path: "Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good." This principle invites us to seek ways to break the cycle, even...
reflection.zh: 无人机从伊拉克袭击沙特阿拉伯的东西输油管道，这说明了冲突的破坏性循环。在这样的时刻，人们很容易以进一步的侵略来回应。然而，圣经呼唤我们走一条更高的道路：“不要被邪恶打败，要以善胜恶。”这一原则邀请我们在面对直接攻击时，也要寻求打破循环的方法。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

title.en: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
title.zh: 沙特因无人机袭击关闭关键石油管道，袭击来自伊拉克

summary.en: Saudi Arabia has shut down its critical East-West oil pipeline after it was targeted by drones launched from Iraq. Iraq has stated it has dismissed a military commander and initiated an investigation into the attack, which originated from a province bordering Iran. This incident occurs amidst escalating tensions in...
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯在其关键的东西输油管道遭到来自伊拉克的无人机袭击后，已将其关闭。伊拉克方面表示，已解雇一名军事指挥官并展开调查，此次袭击源自其与伊朗接壤的一个省份。此次事件发生在地区紧张局势加剧的背景下，包括胡塞武装在也门的重大进展以及美伊之间持续的冲突。

body.en:
Saudi Arabia has closed a critical oil pipeline after it was attacked by drones launched from Iraq, as conflict in the Middle East widens.

Iraq said it had fired a military commander and launched an investigation after admitting the drone attack on its neighbour's East-West pipeline had originated in one of its provinces bordering Iran.

The 1,200km (745 mile) pipeline has helped Saudi Arabia - the world's largest crude oil exporter - bypass the Strait of Hormuz.

The incident comes amid a major advance by the Iranian-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen, putting more pressure on global oil shipping routes as the US-Iran war stretches into its seventh month.

Riyadh on Friday said it had shut the pipeline as a precaution, as satellite images of scorched ground and smoke near the site emerged.

The foreign ministry said the attack resulted in some injuries and damage, which was still being assessed.

The pipeline has been moving 4% to 5% of global oil supply, news agency Reuters has reported, citing ship tracking companies and analysts.

Saudi Arabia has chosen not to retaliate at this stage, its foreign ministry says, following a call from Iraq's prime minister.

It said the kingdom would "support the efforts of the Iraqi government" to "prevent attacks" launched from the country against neighbouring states.

"The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia affirms that it reserves its right to take all necessary measures to safeguard its sovereignty and security, protect its facilities, and ensure the safety of its citizens and residents," the statement added.

The Iraqi prime minister's office in its own statement said the operations commander in the Maysan governorate - a province which borders Iran - had been removed from his post following confirmation the drone attack had been launched from that region.

The Gulf Co-operation Council – made up of representatives from the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar and Kuwait – also issued a missive condemning the attack.

"This attack represents a dangerous escalation and an unacceptable threat to the security of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, its territorial integrity, and its vital installations, as well as a flagrant violation of the principles of international law," secretary general Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi.

This week, a lightning advance in Yemen has also seen Houthi militants seize control of much of the country's coastline , sources say.

The group claims it has control of the Bab al-Mandab Strait, the gateway to the Red Sea and the Suez Canal, though it says maritime navigation is "safe for all companies except for Saudi vessels".

The developments have squeezed both sides of the Arabian Peninsula, pushing crude oil prices to over $100 a barrel for the first time since July .
body.zh: 随着中东冲突扩大，沙特阿拉伯在遭到从伊拉克发射的无人机袭击后关闭了一条重要的石油管道。 伊拉克表示，在承认对其邻国​​东西方管道的无人机袭击起源于与伊朗接壤的一个省份后，该国已解雇一名军事指挥官并展开调查。 这条 1,200 公里（745 英里）的管道帮助世界最大的原油出口国沙特阿拉伯绕过了霍尔木兹海峡。 此次事件发生之际，伊朗支持的胡塞叛军在也门取得重大进展，随着美伊战争进入第七个月，给全球石油运输路线带来了更大的压力。 利雅得周五表示，作为预防措施，它已关闭管道，因为卫星图像显示现场附近烧焦的地面和烟雾。 外交部表示，袭击造成一些人受伤和损失，目前仍在评估中。 据路透社援引船舶追踪公司和分析师的报道，该管道输送了全球 4% 至 5% 的石油供应。 在接到伊拉克总理的电话后，沙特外交部表示，沙特阿拉伯选择现阶段不进行报复。 声明称，沙特将“支持伊拉克政府的努力”，以“防止伊拉克对邻国发动袭击”。 声明补充说：“沙特阿拉伯王国申明保留采取一切必要措施维护其主权和安全、保护其设施并确保其公民和居民安全的权利。” 伊拉克总理办公室在自己的声明中表示，在确认无人机袭击是从该地区发动后，与伊朗接壤的米桑省的行动指挥官已被免职。 由阿拉伯联合酋长国、巴林、阿曼、卡塔尔和科威特代表组成的海湾合作委员会也发表了一封信，谴责这次袭击。 秘书长贾西姆·穆罕默德·阿尔布代维表示：“这次袭击是危险的升级，对沙特阿拉伯王国的安全、领土完整及其重要设施构成不可接受的威胁，也是对国际法原则的公然违反。” 消息人士称，本周，胡塞武装在也门闪电般推进，夺取了该国大部分海岸线的控制权。 该组织声称它控制着通往红海和苏伊士运河的门户曼德海峡，尽管它表示海上航行“对除沙特船只之外的所有公司来说都是安全的”。 这些事态发展对阿拉伯半岛双方造成了挤压，原油价格自 7 月以来首次突破每桶 100 美元。

reflection.en: The drone attack on Saudi Arabia's oil pipeline and the subsequent closure of the pipeline illustrate the dangerous cycle of retaliation in the Middle East. The temptation is to respond with force, escalating the conflict further. Yet, Scripture calls us to a different path: 'Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.' This requires seeking...
reflection.zh: 沙特阿拉伯石油管道遭无人机袭击及随后关闭管道的事件，凸显了中东地区危险的报复循环。人们很容易倾向于以武力回应，从而进一步加剧冲突。然而，圣经呼吁我们走另一条道路：“不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。”这要求我们即使面对侵略，也要寻求缓和局势、打破循环的方法。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Death toll from Philippines ferry fire climbs to 35, with dozens still missing
title.zh: 菲律宾渡轮火灾死亡人数升至35人，数十人仍失踪

summary.en: The Philippine Coast Guard has recovered 30 bodies from the wreckage of a ferry that caught fire this week, bringing the total death toll to 35. Over 130 people were on board the MV June Aster when the blaze erupted near Coron. Searches continue for more than 50 people who remain unaccounted for, with access to the...
summary.zh: 菲律宾海岸警卫队已从本周起火的渡轮残骸中找到30具遗体，使死亡总人数达到35人。本周三，载有超过130名乘客的“六月星辰”号渡轮在靠近科隆旅游胜地时发生火灾。仍有超过50人下落不明，搜救工作因船上弥漫的有毒烟雾和高温而受阻。

body.en:
The Philippine Coast Guard says it has recovered 30 bodies from the wreckage of a ferry that caught fire this week, bringing the total death toll to 35.

More than 130 people were on board the MV June Aster when the blaze erupted on Wednesday as it neared its destination at the tourist hotspot of Coron, after departing from Manila.

Forty-three people were rescued, with many receiving treatment in hospital, and searches continue for more than 50 people who remain unaccounted for.

The country's coast guard says more bodies remain on the boat, which they were unable to board until Friday due to toxic fumes and lingering heat.

In a press conference, coast guard spokesperson Commodore Noemie Cayabyab said most bodies had been retrieved from the sleeping area of the boat, which had been making a 22-hour journey.

"Agencies are currently undertaking the proper recovery and identification of the remains in accordance with established procedures," Cayabyab said.

Earlier, the coast guard said preliminary interviews with the survivors suggest that the fire started in the cargo hold. Some passengers were not wearing life vests, they noted.

A survivor who was hauled to safety on a rescue boat told the BBC he had heard frantic cries onboard when the fire erupted, and was trampled by panicked people as he tried to escape.

The Philippines' maritime authority is investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident.

The ferry, built in 2002, held valid safety certificates and passed an enforcement inspection in March, but investigators are looking into potential manifest discrepancies, cargo loading integrity, and crew emergency response protocols, the Palawan Daily reported.

Atienza Interisland Ferries, the vessel's operator, has pledged full cooperation with the inquiry.

"Our hearts remain with the affected families, and we will not rest until all individuals are accounted for," the company said in a statement on Thursday.
body.zh: 菲律宾海岸警卫队表示，已从本周起火的一艘渡轮残骸中打捞出 30 具尸体，使总死亡人数达到 35 人。 周三，MV June Aster 从马尼拉出发，接近目的地旅游胜地科隆时发生火灾，船上有 130 多人。 43 人获救，其中许多人在医院接受治疗，目前仍有 50 多人下落不明，搜救工作仍在继续。 该国海岸警卫队表示，船上仍有更多尸体，由于有毒烟雾和持续高温，他们直到周五才登上船。 海岸警卫队发言人诺埃米·卡亚比亚布准将在新闻发布会上表示，大多数尸体已从这艘船的睡眠区打捞出来，这艘船已经航行了 22 小时。 卡亚比亚布说：“各机构目前正在按照既定程序对遗骸进行适当的回收和鉴定。” 早些时候，海岸警卫队表示，对幸存者的初步采访表明火灾是从货舱开始的。他们指出，一些乘客没有穿救生衣。 一名被救生船救到安全地带的幸存者告诉英国广播公司，火灾爆发时，他听到船上传来疯狂的呼喊声，当他试图逃跑时，他被惊慌失措的人们践踏。 菲律宾海事当局正在调查该事件的相关情况。 据《巴拉望日报》报道，这艘渡轮建于 2002 年，持有有效的安全证书，并于 3 月份通过了执法检查，但调查人员正在调查潜在的清单差异、货物装载完整性和船员应急响应协议。 该船的运营商 Atienza Interisland Ferries 已承诺全力配合调查。 该公司在周四的一份声明中表示：“我们的心与受影响的家庭同在，在所有人员都被查明之前，我们不会休息。”

reflection.en: The tragic fire on the MV June Aster ferry, claiming 35 lives and leaving many families in suspense, evokes profound grief. In moments like these, the biblical vision of a redeemed creation offers solace. Revelation 21:4 promises a time when Yahweh will wipe away every tear, and death, mourning, and pain will be no more.
reflection.zh: “六月星辰”号渡轮上发生的悲惨火灾，夺走了35人的生命，让许多家庭陷入痛苦的等待。在这样的时刻，圣经中关于被救赎的创造的异象带来了慰藉。《启示录》21章4节应许，雅伟将擦去一切眼泪，不再有死亡，也不再有悲伤、哭泣和痛苦。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: 'Everything has fallen': Iran-backed militants capture Red Sea gateway to blockade global shipping
title.zh: 伊朗支持的武装分子占领红海门户以封锁全球航运

summary.en: Houthi rebels have completed their takeover of the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a critical Red Sea gateway, leading to disruptions in global shipping and Saudi Arabia shutting down an oil pipeline following attacks.
summary.zh: 胡塞武装分子已完成对红海关键门户曼德海峡的全面控制，导致全球航运中断，沙特阿拉伯在遭受袭击后关闭了一条石油管道。

body.en:
The Iran-backed Houthis have seized control of Yemen's entire Red Sea coast and captured three strategic islands in a lightning offensive that cemented their hold on a vital shipping corridor linking Europe and Asia.

The developments are likely to deepen the Middle East war's impact on international commerce, as Saudi Arabia shut down an oil pipeline following attacks, and after months of Iran's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

Following a week-long offensive that has left hundreds dead, government officials said the Houthis seized the Yemeni side of the Bab al-Mandab Strait, the southern gateway to the Red Sea and the Suez Canal.

A local official with Yemen's Saudi-backed government said the Houthis had "completed their takeover of the Bab al-Mandab area and Mayyun Island".

A government military official later reported the group had also seized Greater and Lesser Hanish, the last two islands in the narrow waterway not under their control, as well as all of the neighbouring Red Sea coastline.

"Everything that was under our control on the western coast has fallen," the military official added.

A witness told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency that gunmen were "deploying along the Bab al-Mandab shore and are driving around in military vehicles".

The capture of the islands, particularly Mayyun in the middle of the strait, heightens the Houthis' ability to attack Saudi tankers, which they have been targeting since July.

Saudi Arabia, the world's biggest oil exporter, has relied on the Red Sea ever since Iran's Hormuz blockade choked off its shipments via the Gulf.

Mohammad Mokhber, an adviser to Iranian supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei, congratulated the Houthis on their "resounding victory".

Farea Al-Muslimi, research fellow at Chatham House, told AFP: "Now the Iranians don't only control... the Strait of Hormuz, but they control the other most strategic chokepoint in the Middle East."

Oil prices have soared past US $100 ($139.5) a barrel this week, while average US diesel prices topped US $6 ($8.4) for the first time on Friday — a potential headache for President Donald Trump ahead of midterm elections.

The Houthis' military spokesman, Yahya Saree, said navigation through the Bab al-Mandab Strait was "safe" for all but Saudi Arabia following the latest advances.

The Houthi offensive has killed more than 500 people, according to sources on both sides.

It is part of renewed hostilities in Yemen's civil war that began with the group's takeover of the capital Sanaa in 2014.

title.en: Iran pursues cautious escalation ahead of US midterms
title.zh: 伊朗在中期选举前寻求谨慎升级

summary.en: Tehran appears to be increasing pressure on Washington ahead of the crucial US midterm elections, but it shows little inclination to return to a full-scale war.
summary.zh: 在关键的美国中期选举前，德黑兰似乎正在加大对华盛顿的压力，但其并无意愿重回全面战争。

body.en:
Tehran appears to be boosting pressure on Washington ahead of the crucial midterm vote, but shows little desire to return to a full-scale war.

The war with Iran "is going to end immediately after the [US midterm] election because they can't hold out any longer," US President Donald Trump said of Iran's leaders on Wednesday. 

Speaking at the Republican midterm convention,  the first such event to be held at a massive arena in Dallas, Texas, Trump described the November 3 vote as "one of the most important elections of your lives," and once again defended the war against Iran.

The US president restated his argument that he had launched the attacks to prevent Tehran from developing a nuclear weapon. He also promised that oil prices would fall as soon as the US had won the war.

But even if Trump's promises are taken at face value, rising gas prices are sure to hurt Republicans' electoral prospects in the midterms .

On Wednesday, Brent crude — the global benchmark for prices — jumped to over $100 (€86) per barrel. The fighting escalated again this week, with the US striking Iranian oil tankers in retaliation for Iran's targeting of a US warship.

"Iran still appears to see escalation primarily as a controlled instrument of coercive bargaining, rather than as an end in itself," said Mohammad Ghaedi, a Middle East expert and professor at the Department of Political Science at George Washington University.

"Iran is trying to impose costs on the United States without raising those costs so dramatically that Washington feels compelled to return to full-scale war," he explained.

"That helps explain why the number of missiles fired at US naval vessels has remained relatively limited."

The regime wants to demonstrate that it can threaten US forces and disrupt the maritime traffic in the region, the expert said, "but it also wants to keep the confrontation below a threshold that could trigger a much larger American response."

Tehran's preferred outcome would be a return to the Memorandum of Understanding signed in Islamabad in June , Ghaedi said, referring to a preliminary deal that paused the full-scale conflict. 

At the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in late August, Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian reiterated that, if the United States returns to the memorandum, Iran would return as well.

Ghaedi said the first provision of the memorandum presents a major obstacle, as it requires an Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon — "something Tehran sees as unlikely before Israel's elections."

body.zh: 在关键的中期投票之前，德黑兰似乎正在加大对华盛顿的压力，但并没有表现出重返全面战争的意愿。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周三在谈到伊朗领导人时表示，与伊朗的战争“将在[美国中期]选举后立即结束，因为他们无法再坚持下去了”。 共和党中期代表大会是首次在德克萨斯州达拉斯的大型舞台上举行的此类活动，特朗普在会上发表讲话，称 11 月 7 日的投票是“你们一生中最重要的选举之一”，并再次为针对伊朗的战争辩护。 美国总统重申了他的论点，即他发动袭击是为了阻止德黑兰发展核武器。他还承诺，一旦美国赢得战争，油价就会下跌。 但即使特朗普的承诺得到了兑现，油价上涨也肯定会损害共和党在中期选举中的选举前景。 周三，全球价格基准布伦特原油价格跃升至每桶 100 美元以上（86 欧元）。本周，战斗再次升级，美国袭击了伊朗油轮，以报复伊朗袭击美国军舰。 中东问题专家、乔治华盛顿大学政治学系教授穆罕默德·盖迪表示：“伊朗似乎仍然主要将升级视为强制谈判的受控工具，而不是其本身。” 他解释说：“伊朗试图让美国付出代价，但又不想让这些代价大幅增加，以致华盛顿感到有必要重返全面战争。” “这有助于解释为什么向美国海军舰艇发射的导弹数量仍然相对有限。” 专家表示，该政权希望证明它可以威胁美军并扰乱该地区的海上交通，“但它也希望将对抗控制在可能引发美国更大规模反应的阈值以下。” 加迪表示，德黑兰最希望的结果是恢复六月份在伊斯兰堡签署的谅解备忘录，他指的是一项暂停全面冲突的初步协议。 在八月下旬的上海合作组织峰会上，伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安重申，如果美国返回该备忘录，伊朗也会返回。 加迪表示，备忘录的第一条规定是一个主要障碍，因为它要求以色列从黎巴嫩撤军——“德黑兰认为在以色列选举之前这是不可能的”。 以色列将于 10 月 27 日投票选举新议会，就在美国即将举行中期投票的几天前。 在德黑兰，许多人认为冲突的决定性转折点......

reflection.en: As geopolitical tensions rise ahead of the US midterm elections, Iran is reportedly increasing pressure on Washington. This situation highlights the delicate balance between asserting influence and avoiding full-scale conflict. The call to live peaceably with all, as much as it depends on us, is a constant challenge in international relations.
reflection.zh: 在美国中期选举前地缘政治紧张局势加剧之际，据报道伊朗正在加大对华盛顿的压力。这种情况凸显了施加影响与避免全面冲突之间的微妙平衡。‘尽力而为，与众人和睦’的呼吁在国际关系中是一个持续的挑战。

summary.en: India's foreign policy, termed "America Plus," involves strengthening relationships with China and Russia while simultaneously attempting to prevent the BRICS bloc from becoming an anti-Western alliance. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to host the BRICS summit in New Delhi, where he will welcome Chinese President...
summary.zh: 印度奉行的“美国优先”外交政策，旨在深化与中国和俄罗斯的关系，同时努力阻止金砖国家集团成为反西方联盟。印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪将主办金砖国家峰会，并欢迎中国国家主席习近平访问新德里，这是自2019年以来习近平首次访印。此次峰会在印度金砖国家轮值主席国任期即将结束的关键时刻举行，印度正加紧与中国和俄罗斯的接触，而与华盛顿的...

body.en:
New Delhi's "America Plus" approach sees India deepening its ties with China and Russia, while also trying to keep BRICS from turning into an anti-Western platform.

India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi will host the 18th BRICS summit this weekend in New Delhi, welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping to India for the first time since 2019.   

The summit comes at an important moment for India . As New Delhi's year-long BRICS presidency draws to a close, India is stepping up engagement with China and Russia , and its relationship with Washington remains difficult .

Modi met both Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, on August 31 and September 1. Just two weeks later, Modi is set to see them again in New Delhi for the BRICS summit.

But with BRICS both growing in size and increasingly troubled by internal divisions, the forum might limit Modi's diplomatic gains.

Indian diplomats are trying to protect their room for maneuver in a changing international order.

Ashok Kantha, a former Indian ambassador to China, said India's engagement with BRICS and the SCO is part of New Delhi's longstanding strategy of strategic autonomy.

"These groupings give India a seat at the table and allow it to pursue its own interests while maintaining relationships with different major powers," Kantha told DW.

However, as Modi prepares to host Xi in New Delhi, ties between India and China are less than ideal .

Both countries reached a border patrol agreement in 2024, ending a four-year military standoff along their disputed frontier.

International flights have resumed, the Kailash Mansarovar pilgrimage has reopened and some visa restrictions have eased. But major problems remain between Beijing and New Delhi — India is reporting a trade deficit of over $112 billion (€96.5 billion) with China, and the two countries argue over market access.

The Modi-Xi meeting will therefore be watched for signs of a major diplomatic thaw, particularly on trade and investment.

Kantha said the visit could bring some stabilization but should not be mistaken for a reset.

"The border remains heavily militarized and major differences over trade, investment and security remain. India needs a stable and predictable relationship with China, but without lowering its guard," said Kantha.

"It is a relationship of armed coexistence and managed competition. We should not reduce it to a simple 'elephant and dragon' story," he said, referring to traditional symbols of the world's two most populous nations.

India's presidency has already exposed the difficulty of reaching agreement within BRICS, which has grown from its original five members to 11.

body.zh: 新德里的“美国+”方针让印度加深了与中国和俄罗斯的关系，同时也试图阻止金砖国家变成一个反西方的平台。 印度总理莫迪将于本周末在新德里主办金砖国家领导人第十八次峰会，欢迎中国国家主席习近平自 2019 年以来首次访问印度。 此次峰会对印度来说正值重要时刻。随着新德里为期一年的金砖国家轮值主席国任期接近尾声，印度正在加强与中国和俄罗斯的接触，其与华盛顿的关系仍然困难。 莫迪于8月31日和9月1日在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会上会见了习近平和俄罗斯总统普京。仅仅两周后，莫迪将在新德里出席金砖国家峰会时再次会见他们。 但随着金砖国家规模不断扩大，内部分歧日益困扰，该论坛可能会限制莫迪的外交成果。 印度外交官正试图在不断变化的国际秩序中保护自己的回旋余地。 印度前驻华大使阿肖克·坎塔表示，印度与金砖国家和上合组织的接触是新德里长期战略自主战略的一部分。 坎塔对德国之声表示：“这些组织让印度在谈判桌上占有一席之地，并使其能够在与不同大国保持关系的同时追求自身利益。” 然而，当莫迪准备在新德里接待习近平时，印度和中国之间的关系并不理想。 两国于 2024 年达成边境巡逻协议，结束了两国争议边境长达四年的军事对峙。 国际航班已恢复，神山朝圣活动已重新开放，一些签证限制也已放宽。但北京和新德里之间仍存在重大问题——印度报告的对华贸易逆差超过1120亿美元（965亿欧元），两国在市场准入问题上存在争议。 因此，莫迪与习近平的会晤将受到重大外交解冻的迹象，特别是在贸易和投资方面。 坎塔表示，这次访问可能会带来一些稳定，但不应被误认为是重置。 坎塔表示：“边境仍然高度军事化，贸易、投资和安全方面的重大分歧依然存在。印度需要与中国建立稳定和可预测的关系，但又不能放松警惕。” “这是一种武装共存和有管理的竞争的关系。我们不应将其简化为一个简单的‘象与龙’故事，”他说，他指的是世界上人口最多的两个国家的传统象征。 印度担任轮值主席国已经暴露了金砖国家内部达成协议的难度，金砖国家成员已从最初的5个增加到11个。 与巴西、南非、印度尼西亚等国家...

body.zh: 新德里的“美国+”方针让印度加深了与中国和俄罗斯的关系，同时也试图阻止金砖国家变成一个反西方的平台。 印度总理莫迪将于本周末在新德里主办金砖国家领导人第十八次峰会，欢迎中国国家主席习近平自 2019 年以来首次访问印度。 此次峰会对印度来说正值重要时刻。随着新德里为期一年的金砖国家轮值主席国任期接近尾声，印度正在加强与中国和俄罗斯的接触，其与华盛顿的关系仍然困难。 莫迪于8月31日和9月1日在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会上会见了习近平和俄罗斯总统普京。仅仅两周后，莫迪将在新德里出席金砖国家峰会时再次会见他们。 但随着金砖国家规模不断扩大，内部分歧日益困扰，该论坛可能会限制莫迪的外交成果。 印度外交官正试图在不断变化的国际秩序中保护自己的回旋余地。 印度前驻华大使阿肖克·坎塔表示，印度与金砖国家和上合组织的接触是新德里长期战略自主战略的一部分。 坎塔对德国之声表示：“这些组织让印度在谈判桌上占有一席之地，并使其能够在与不同大国保持关系的同时追求自身利益。” 然而，当莫迪准备在新德里接待习近平时，印度和中国之间的关系并不理想。 两国于 2024 年达成边境巡逻协议，结束了两国争议边境长达四年的军事对峙。 国际航班已恢复，神山朝圣活动已重新开放，一些签证限制也已放宽。但北京和新德里之间仍存在重大问题——印度报告的对华贸易逆差超过1120亿美元（965亿欧元），两国在市场准入问题上存在争议。 因此，莫迪与习近平的会晤将受到重大外交解冻的迹象，特别是在贸易和投资方面。 坎塔表示，这次访问可能会带来一些稳定，但不应被误认为是重置。 坎塔表示：“边境仍然高度军事化，贸易、投资和安全方面的重大分歧依然存在。印度需要与中国建立稳定和可预测的关系，但又不能放松警惕。” “这是一种武装共存和有管理的竞争的关系。我们不应将其简化为一个简单的‘象与龙’故事，”他说，他指的是世界上人口最多的两个国家的传统象征。 印度担任轮值主席国已经暴露了金砖国家内部达成协议的难度，金砖国家成员已从最初的5个增加到11个。 与巴西、南非、印度尼西亚等国家...

reflection.en: In a world often defined by division, India's diplomatic approach seeks a delicate balance. The upcoming BRICS summit in New Delhi, with leaders from China and Russia attending, presents an opportunity for dialogue and the pursuit of peace, even amidst complex international relations. May wisdom guide these leaders as they navigate the path toward mutual...
reflection.zh: 在一个常常被分裂所定义的世界上，印度的外交方针寻求微妙的平衡。即将在新德里举行的金砖国家峰会，中国和俄罗斯的领导人将出席，这为对话和寻求和平提供了机会，即使在复杂国际关系中也是如此。愿智慧引导这些领导人，在寻求相互理解与合作的道路上。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: BRICS Summit 2026: China's Xi to meet Modi today
title.zh: 金砖国家峰会2026：中国习近平今日会见莫迪

summary.en: Xi's visit to India holds significance as it is his first since the deadly 2020 military clash between India and China over Galwan Valley. Follow DW for more.
summary.zh: 习近平此次访问印度意义重大，这是自2020年印中两国在加勒万河谷发生致命军事冲突以来的首次访问。请关注DW获取更多信息。

body.en:
Xi's visit to India holds significance as it is his first since the deadly 2020 military clash between India and China over Galwan Valley. Follow DW for more.

Tired of missing our real-time updates?  Click here to add us as a Preferred Source on Google . Then tap the "Star" or "Preferred" to keep DW News at the top of your feed.

China's President Xi Jinping landed in Delhi this morning to attend the 18th BRICS Summit and hold talks with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi .

"At noon on September 12, local time, President Xi Jinping arrived in New Delhi by special plane. He will attend the 18th BRICS summit at the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi," Chinese state broadcaster CCTV said.

This is Xi's first visit to India since 2019, marking the biggest step toward normalizing ties between the two Asian powers, which took a major hit when India and China locked horns in the deadliest clash in over four decades over the disputed border in Ladakh's Galwan Valley.

The two countries have also sparred over Arunachal Pradesh's geographical names.

Xi's visit now signals the importance accorded by China to BRICS as well as maintaining ties with India.

Ahead of Xi's visit, in a post on X, China's ambassador to India Xu Feihong said that China will work with India to "properly handle differences" and "be friends enjoying good-neighborliness and partners helping each other succeed."

Modi and Xi are scheduled to meet on the sidelines of BRICS at 5.45 p.m. local time (1215 GMT). In their meeting, the two leaders are expected to focus on bilateral trade and border issues .

We are resuming our coverage of the BRICS Summit 2026, taking place in New Delhi at the Bharat Mandapam.

Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi held bilateral meetings with Russian President Vladimir Putin, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and UN Chief Antonio Guterres on the eve of the BRICS Summit.

Modi and Putin reaffirmed their ties. Both the leaders discussed key regional and global issues including the conflicts in the Middle East and the Ukraine war which was referred to as "conflicts in the Black Sea region."

In his meeting with Pezeshkian, Modi thanked the Iranian leader for his participation in the summit "despite the challenging circumstances" for Iran, which is at war with the US and Israel.

Modi also reiterated that "all issues must be resolved through dialogue and diplomacy."

New Delhi's "America Plus" approach sees India deepening its ties with China and Russia, while also trying to keep BRICS from turning into an anti-Western platform.

But with BRICS both growing in size and increasingly troubled by internal divisions, the forum might limit Narendra Modi 's diplomatic gains.

body.zh: 习近平对印度的访问具有重要意义，因为这是自 2020 年印度和中国因加勒万河谷发生致命军事冲突以来他首次访问印度。关注DW了解更多。 厌倦了错过我们的实时更新？ 单击此处将我们添加为 Google 上的首选来源。然后点击“星标”或“首选”，将 DW News 保留在您的 Feed 顶部。 中国国家主席习近平今天上午抵达德里，出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，并与印度总理莫迪举行会谈。 “当地时间9月12日中午，习近平主席乘专机抵达新德里，将应印度总理莫迪邀请出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，”中国中央电视台报道。 这是习近平自2019年以来首次访问印度，标志着这两个亚洲大国关系正常化迈出的最大一步。印度和中国在拉达克加尔万河谷有争议的边界问题上发生了四十多年来最严重的冲突，两国关系遭受了重大打击。 两国还就阿鲁纳恰尔邦的地名发生争执。 习近平的访问体现了中国对金砖国家以及与印度保持关系的重视。 在习近平访问印度之前，中国驻印度大使徐飞洪在《X》上发帖表示，中国将与印方一道“妥善处理分歧”，“做睦邻友好、守望相助的伙伴”。 莫迪和习近平定于下午 5 点 45 分在金砖国家会议期间会面。当地时间（1215 GMT）。预计两国领导人在会晤中将重点讨论双边贸易和边境问题。 我们将继续报道 2026 年金砖国家峰会，该峰会在新德里的 Bharat Mandapam 举行。 印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪在金砖国家峰会前夕与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京、伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安和联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯举行了双边会晤。 莫迪和普京重申了他们的关系。两位领导人讨论了关键的地区和全球问题，包括中东冲突和被称为“黑海地区冲突”的乌克兰战争。 在与佩泽什基安的会面中，莫迪感谢伊朗领导人“尽管面临与美国和以色列交战的伊朗面临的充满挑战的情况”参加峰会。 莫迪还重申“所有问题都必须通过对话和外交解决”。 新德里的“美国+”方针让印度加深了与中国和俄罗斯的关系，同时也试图阻止金砖国家变成一个反西方的平台。 但随着金砖国家规模不断扩大，内部分歧日益困扰，该论坛可能会限制纳伦德拉·莫迪的外交成果。 了解有关印度外交平衡的更多信息......

reflection.en: The leaders of India and China meet amidst lingering tensions from a deadly 2020 border clash. This encounter at the BRICS summit offers a moment for dialogue, a step toward managing conflict and seeking pathways for peaceful coexistence, even when past grievances remain.
reflection.zh: 印度和中国领导人正在处理2020年致命边境冲突遗留的紧张局势。此次在金砖国家峰会上的会晤为对话提供了契机，是管理冲突、寻求和平共处之路的一步，即使过去的怨恨依然存在。

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011. Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

Proverbs 28:15 warns that 'When the wicked rule, people groan.' This verse speaks to the inherent instability and suffering that can arise when power is wielded without accountability, as seen in the continued acceleration of...
reflection.zh: 新闻指出，金正恩政权似乎并未受到外交示好的影响，仍在推进其核野心。箴言 28:15 警告说：“恶人在位，人就叹息。”这节经文呼应了当权力在缺乏问责的情况下被滥用时，可能产生的固有不稳定和苦难，正如在国际关注下朝鲜核计划的持续加速所见。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: China angered by Taiwan VP's visit to EU democracy forum
title.zh: 中国对台湾副总统访问欧盟民主论坛表示愤怒

summary.en: Beijing has lodged a complaint with Italy and the EU over top Taiwanese officials visiting a democracy conference. The EU is navigating contentious issues with China, and high-ranking Taiwanese visits are rare.
summary.zh: 北京就台湾高级官员访问民主会议一事向意大利和欧盟提出抗议。欧盟正在处理与中国的敏感问题，而台湾高级官员的访问非常罕见。

body.en:
Beijing has lodged a complaint with Italy and the EU over top Taiwanese officials visiting a democracy conference. The EU is navigating contentious issues with China and high-ranking Taiwanese visits are rare.

China was angered by Italy and the EU on Friday, lodging "solemn ‌representations" with both after news broke that high-ranking Taiwanese officials had traveled to the bloc to attend an annual democracy summit.

Beijing's Foreign Ministry said it firmly opposes official interactions of any form with Taiwan by nations who have ties with China .

Solemn ‌representations is a literal translation of a Chinese term expressing diplomatic discontent. 

At issue is a visit by Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim and Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung, both of whom were welcomed to the Ventotene Conference for Freedom and Democracy in Italy.

China sees democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory, which it has  vowed to "reunite" with the mainland . 

Beijing has previously blasted Hsiao as an "independence diehard" and has criticized her Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) as a separatist outfit.

Taiwan's government has not sought formal independence but Beijing has, nevertheless, threatened to take the island by military force.

European Parliament Vice President Pina Picierno announced Hsiao and Lin's attendance at the conference early Friday morning, adding that news of the visit had been kept under wraps until they arrived for safety reasons.

The EU's Picierno, who called the visit a "very important message," was defiant on Friday, saying, "No one can decide who is hosted in Ventotene and who is not," and calling out the Chinese "regime" for seeking to interfere. 

Though Taiwanese foreign ministers travel abroad, it is rare for an official as high-ranking as the vice president to visit nations with ties to Beijing for fear of fallout for host countries.

Other prominent pro-democracy advocates such as Russian Kremlin critic Yulia Navalnaya , the wife of the late Alexei Navalny, and Belarus opposition leader Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya are also in attendance. 

Italy, like most nations, is not among Taiwan's 12 formal diplomatic allies, although the Vatican is.

Italy's Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani will not meet with the visiting Taiwanese officials.

The EU is walking a fine line between democratic support for Taiwan and relations with China.

Beijing's support for Russia in its ongoing invasion of Ukraine — which also prompted Taiwan to seek closer ties with the EU in 2022 — has been a thorn in the side of EU nations and in Brussels.

body.zh: 北京已就台湾高级官员参观民主会议向意大利和欧盟提出投诉。欧盟正在处理与中国有争议的问题，台湾高层访问很少。 周五，意大利和欧盟激怒了中国，在台湾高级官员前往欧盟参加年度民主峰会的消息传出后，中国向意大利和欧盟提出了“严正交涉”。 北京外交部表示，坚决反对与中国有联系的国家与台湾进行任何形式的官方互动。 严正交涉是表达外交不满的中文术语的直译。 争论的焦点是副主席萧美琴和外交部长林家龙的访问，他们两人都受到了意大利文托泰内自由民主会议的欢迎。 中国将民主治理的台湾视为自己的领土，并发誓要与大陆“统一”。 北京此前曾抨击萧是“独立顽固分子”，并批评她所在的民进党（DPP）是分裂主义组织。 台湾政府并未寻求正式独立，但北京却威胁要用武力夺取台湾。 欧洲议会副主席皮娜·皮切尔诺周五凌晨宣布萧和林出席会议，并补充说，出于安全原因，在他们抵达之前，此次访问的消息一直处于保密状态。 欧盟委员皮切尔诺称这次访问是一个“非常重要的信息”，他在周五挑衅地说，“没有人可以决定谁在文托泰内接待，谁不接待”，并指责中国“政权”试图干涉。 尽管台湾外长经常出国访问，但像副总统这样的高级官员很少访问与北京有联系的国家，因为担心对东道国造成影响。 其他著名的民主倡导者，如俄罗斯克里姆林宫批评家尤利娅·纳瓦尔纳亚（已故阿列克谢·纳瓦尔尼的妻子）和白俄罗斯反对派领导人斯维亚特兰娜·齐哈努斯卡娅也出席了会议。 与大多数国家一样，意大利并不在台湾的 12 个正式外交盟友之列，但梵蒂冈却在其中。 意大利外交部长安东尼奥·塔亚尼不会会见来访的台湾官员。 欧盟在对台湾的民主支持和与中国的关系之间保持着微妙的平衡。 北京对俄罗斯持续入侵乌克兰的支持——这也促使台湾在 2022 年寻求与欧盟建立更紧密的关系——一直是欧盟国家和布鲁塞尔的眼中钉。 如果您依赖我们团队提供值得信赖的报告，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，以便您始终看到...

reflection.en: Diplomatic tensions often arise from differing political views and national interests. In these moments, the call to live peaceably with all, as much as it depends on us, is a vital reminder for nations and individuals alike. May wisdom guide leaders toward de-escalation and mutual respect.
reflection.zh: 外交紧张局势常常源于不同的政治观点和国家利益。在这些时刻，尽我们所能与人和睦相处的呼吁，对国家和个人来说都是一个重要的提醒。愿智慧引导领导者走向缓和局势和相互尊重。

title.en: Hong Kong Tiananmen activists jailed for up to 7 years
title.zh: 香港天安门案活动人士被判处最高七年监禁

summary.en: Three pro-democracy activists who organized annual commemorations of China's deadly 1989 Tiananmen crackdown were sentenced to between five and seven years in prison under Hong Kong's national security law for "incitement to subversion."
summary.zh: 三名组织纪念中国1989年致命天安门镇压活动的有组织民主活动人士，根据香港国安法被判处五年至七年监禁，罪名为“煽动颠覆”。

body.en:
Three pro-democracy activists who organized annual commemorations of China's deadly 1989 Tiananmen crackdown were charged under Hong Kong's Beijing-backed national security law.

A Hong Kong court on Friday sentenced three pro-democracy activists who organized annual vigils marking China's deadly 1989 Tiananmen crackdown to between five and seven years in prison under the city's national security law .

The three were convicted in August of "incitement to subversion" over their activities with the now-disbanded Hong Kong Alliance, which received a fine of HK$1.5 million ($191,304, €164,768). The alliance had organized annual Tiananmen vigils in Victoria Park.

Judges cited the group's call to "end one-party dictatorship," saying it challenged the legitimacy of Communist Party rule in the Chinese special administrative region. 

Lee and Chow denied the subversion charges under Hong Kong's controversial national security law. The defendants also insisted the alliance had not asked people to do anything illegal. 

The court rejected arguments that the defendants believed they were acting within the law given Hong ​Kong's freedoms of speech, which have been severely curtailed since Beijing imposed the law in 2020 following a crackdown mass pro-democracy protests the previous year.

The vigils, once a major annual event in Hong Kong, have been effectively banned under the law. 

Chow, a barrister who represented herself, raised both arms and waved at supporters as she was escorted out.

Her mother, Medina Chow, addressed her supporters saying, "For today's verdict, you do not need to be overly saddened. Do not lose heart. And above all, do not ​feel guilty."

The convictions have drawn criticism from foreign governments and rights groups.

"This sentencing is a triple tragedy: for the activists being unjustly punished; the survivors and victims of the Tiananmen crackdown itself; and the generations of Hongkongers denied the space to discuss one of the most consequential events in modern Chinese history," said Amnesty International's deputy regional director, Sarah Brooks.

Germany and France last month had condemned the verdict against Chow saying that "peaceful advocacy for human rights does not constitute a crime."

Among those arrested under the security law are pro-democracy former media tycoon Jimmy Lai and former student leader Joshua Wong .

body.zh: 三名民主活动人士因每年组织纪念 1989 年中国致命的天安门镇压活动而受到北京支持的香港国家安全法的指控。 香港一家法院周五根据香港国家安全法判处三名民主活动人士五年至七年监禁，这些活动人士每年组织纪念中国 1989 年天安门镇压事件的守夜活动。 三人于 8 月因与现已解散的香港联盟的活动而被判“煽动颠覆”罪，该联盟被罚款 150 万港元（191,304 美元，164,768 欧元）。该联盟在维多利亚公园组织了一年一度的天安门守夜活动。 法官援引该组织“结束一党专政”的呼吁，称其挑战了共产党在中国特别行政区统治的合法性。 李和周否认了根据香港有争议的国家安全法提出的颠覆罪指控。被告还坚称联盟没有要求人们做任何非法的事情。 鉴于香港的言论自由自去年镇压大规模民主抗议活动后北京于 2020 年实施该法律以来，香港的言论自由受到严重限制，法院驳回了被告认为自己在法律范围内行事的论点。 守夜活动曾经是香港的一项重大年度活动，但实际上已被法律禁止。 周女士是一名代表自己的大律师，她在被护送出去时举起双臂向支持者挥手致意。 她的母亲周美娜对她的支持者说：“对于今天的判决，你们不必过度悲伤。不要灰心。最重要的是，不要感到内疚。” 这些定罪引起了外国政府和人权组织的批评。 国际特赦组织区域副主任萨拉·布鲁克斯 (Sarah Brooks) 表示：“这一判决是一场三重悲剧：活动人士受到不公正的惩罚；天安门镇压本身的幸存者和受害者；几代香港人被剥夺了讨论中国现代历史上最重要事件之一的空间。” 德国和法国上个月谴责了对周的判决，称“和平倡导人权并不构成犯罪”。 根据国安法被捕的人包括民主派前媒体大亨黎智英和前学生领袖黄之锋。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The sentencing of these activists underscores a deep yearning for remembrance and justice, a cry for accountability that echoes through the years. The pursuit of truth, even when met with severe penalties, reflects a profound human need to acknowledge past wrongs and seek a more just future.
reflection.zh: 对这些活动人士的判决，凸显了对纪念和伸张正义的深切渴望，这是多年来挥之不去的对问责的呼唤。追求真相，即使面临严厉的惩罚，也反映了人类承认过去的错误并寻求更公正未来的深刻需求。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...

Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。
