In the face of such loss, the ancient call to 'learn to do good; seek justice, rebuke the insolent, aid the orphan, plead for the widow' (Isaiah 1:17) echoes. May we approach such tragedies with a desire for understanding...
reflection.zh: 一名女子遗体被发现，引发了关于她生平、旅程以及导致她走到这一步的境况的深刻疑问。面对这样的损失，古老的呼召“你们要学习行善，寻求公平，解救被欺压的，给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇争辩”（以赛亚书 1:17）回响在耳边。愿我们以寻求理解的态度和维护每一个生命尊严的承诺来面对这样的悲剧。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: 'HK remains calm though undercurrents remain'
title.zh: 香港保持平静，但暗流依然存在

summary.en: Hong Kong remains calm, but underlying tensions persist, according to Police Commissioner Joe Chow. He commented on the sentencing of three former leaders of the now-defunct Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, who received prison terms ranging from five years and two months to...
summary.zh: 香港警方负责人周一岳表示，尽管香港表面平静，但暗流依然存在。他是在回应香港市民支援爱国民主运动联合会（支联会）三名前领导人被判刑一事时发表此番言论的。这三名前领导人因与六四维园烛光晚会相关的活动被判处五年零两个月至七年零三个月不等的监禁。周一岳在周六的一次结业仪式后对记者说，此案并非普通的国安案件，判决反映了案件的严重...

body.en: Police Commissioner Joe Chow said undercurrents remain in Hong Kong, even though the city itself is calm, as he responded to the sentencing of three former leaders of the group behind the June 4th vigils. He made the comments after three former leaders of the now‑defunct Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China – Albert Ho, Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang‑tung – received prison terms on Friday ranging from five years and two months to seven years and three months. Speaking to reporters after a passing-out parade on Saturday, Chow said the case was not an ordinary national security case, and that the sentences reflected its seriousness. "I think this very clearly shows that there is still a small minority of people who hope that in Hong Kong’s calm society, they can incite others, so that others will make some very unreasonable slanders against the central government or the local SAR government," he said. "So for us, we still cannot lower our guard. It is also often said that this is not only the responsibility of the police force; in fact, it should be the responsibility of every ordinary member of the public." Chow added that people must notify the police of any public processions under the Public Order Ordinance. "Our police will carry out risk assessments based on different factors, including national security, public safety, public order, or whether the rights of the public, or the rights of other members of the public who do not participate, may be affected," he said. The government, meanwhile, strongly condemned various western countries and anti-China media that launched “malicious attacks, smears and slanders” after the sentences were handed down. "These external forces adopt double standard to attack the SAR for fulfilling its duty to safeguard national security in strict adherence to the principle of the rule of law. This is complete hypocrisy and a despicable political manoeuvre," said a government spokesman in a statement. The spokesman added that human rights in Hong Kong shall be respected and protected in safeguarding national security, stressing that authorities are committed to ensuring that laws are observed and strictly enforced. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 警务处处长周祖宗在回应 6 月 4 日守夜活动背后组织的三名前领导人被判刑时表示，尽管香港本身平静，但暗流仍然存在。他发表上述言论之前，现已解散的香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟的三名前领导人——何俊仁、李卓人和周恒东——于周五被判处五年零两个月至七年零三个月不等的徒刑。周六的结业游行结束后，周先生对记者表示，此案不是普通的国家安全案件，判决反映了案件的严重性。他说：“我认为这非常清楚地表明，仍然有一小部分人希望在香港平静的社会中，煽动别人，让别人对中央政府或当地特区政府做出一些非常无理的诽谤。” “所以对我们来说，还是不能放松警惕。也常有人说，这不只是警察的责任，其实应该是每一个普通市民的责任。”周补充说，根据《公安条例》，人们必须将任何公众游行通知警方。他说：“我们的警方会根据不同因素进行风险评估，包括国家安全、公共安全、公共秩序，或者公众的权利或其他不参与的公众的权利是否可能受到影响。”与此同时，政府强烈谴责西方国家和反华媒体在判决宣判后发起的“恶意攻击、抹黑和诽谤”。政府发言人在声明中表示，这些外部势力采取双重标准攻击特区严格按照法治原则履行维护国家安全的职责，这完全是虚伪的政治伎俩。发言人补充说，香港的人权在维护国家安全时应得到尊重和保障，并强调当局致力于确保法律得到遵守和严格执行。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The Police Commissioner notes that while Hong Kong appears calm, 'undercurrents remain.' This suggests a society holding its breath, where outward peace masks deeper, unresolved issues. The sentencing of former leaders, while bringing a legal conclusion, does not erase these underlying currents. The call to 'live peaceably with all' (Romans 12:18) reminds...
reflection.zh: 香港警方负责人指出，尽管香港表面平静，但“暗流依然存在”。这表明社会可能处于一种屏息的状态，外在的平静掩盖着更深层次、尚未解决的问题。对前领导人的判决，虽然带来了法律上的了结，但并未消除这些暗流。《罗马书》12:18 提醒我们“倘若可行，总要尽力与众人和睦”。真正的和平不仅在于没有冲突，更在于积极追求和解，即使过程艰难。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Police freeze HK$30 million in bank account of man who refused to share Mark Six prize
title.zh: 警方冻结拒绝分享彩票奖金男子的3000万港元银行账户

summary.en: Hong Kong police have frozen HK$30 million (US$3.8 million) in the bank account of a 36-year-old man arrested on suspicion of theft. He allegedly refused to share a winning Mark Six lottery jackpot with 14 colleagues who had pooled money to buy the ticket.
summary.zh: 香港警方已冻结一名36岁男子银行账户中的3000万港元（约合380万美元），该男子因涉嫌盗窃被捕。他据称拒绝与14名同事分享一张他们合资购买的中奖彩票。

body.en: Hong Kong police have frozen HK$30 million (US$3.8 million) held in the bank account of a 36-year-old man who was arrested on suspicion of theft after he allegedly refused to split a winning Mark Six jackpot with his colleagues. The arrest was made on Friday after a 53-year-old man reported to police on Wednesday that he was one of 15 colleagues who had chipped in to buy the winning ticket for the draw last week, according to a source. The group reportedly included some staff members of the Food...
body.zh: 香港警方冻结了一名 36 岁男子银行账户中的 3000 万港元（合 380 万美元），这名男子因涉嫌盗窃而被捕，据称他拒绝与同事分享中奖的马克六号大奖。据消息人士透露，周三，一名 53 岁男子向警方报案，他是上周凑钱购买中奖彩票的 15 名同事之一，随后周五逮捕了他。据报道，该组织包括食品部门的一些工作人员……

reflection.en: The pursuit of wealth can lead individuals down paths of conflict and legal trouble, as seen in this case where a lottery win allegedly caused a dispute among colleagues. The Bible warns that the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil, and this situation illustrates how greed can quickly turn a potential blessing into a source of strife and...
reflection.zh: 对财富的追求可能将个人引向冲突和法律麻烦，正如本案所示，一次彩票中奖据称在同事间引发了纠纷。《圣经》警告说，贪财是万恶之源，这种情况说明了贪婪如何能迅速将一份潜在的祝福变成纷争和指控的根源。 愿我们寻求知足和正直的品格，并牢记，真正的财富并非以银行存款衡量，而是以忠诚和正确的关系来衡量。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Hong Kong to table cooling-off period bill for beauty, fitness deals by mid-2027
title.zh: 香港就美容、健身交易推出冷静期法案，最快2027年中提交

summary.en: Hong Kong's government plans to introduce a bill in the first half of 2027 that will establish a statutory cooling-off period for prepaid beauty and fitness contracts. This move follows a two-month public consultation aimed at addressing limitations in current trade descriptions laws.
summary.zh: 香港政府计划在2027年上半年向立法会提交一项法案，为预付美容和健身合同引入法定冷静期。此举是在政府于8月31日结束了为期两个月的政策提案公众咨询后提出的，旨在解决《贸易说明条例》的局限性。

body.en: The Hong Kong government will table a bill at the Legislative Council in the first half of 2027 to introduce a statutory cooling-off period for prepaid beauty and fitness contracts, the commerce chief has said. Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau Ying-wah revealed the timeline on Saturday, two weeks after the government concluded a two-month consultation on the policy proposal to address limitations of the Trade Descriptions Ordinance on August 31. “We hope to table the...
body.zh: 商务部负责人表示，香港政府将于 2027 年上半年向立法会提交一项法案，为预付费美容和健身合同引入法定冷静期。商务及经济发展局局长邱英华于周六透露了时间表，两周前，政府于 8 月 31 日结束了为期两个月的政策建议咨询，以解决《商品说明条例》的限制。“我们希望...

reflection.en: This legislative effort in Hong Kong seeks to protect consumers from potentially predatory sales practices in the beauty and fitness industries. It reflects a commitment to ensuring fair dealings and providing recourse for those who may feel pressured into long-term contracts. The principle of justice and mercy calls for such protections, ensuring that...
reflection.zh: 香港这项立法工作旨在保护消费者免受美容和健身行业中可能存在的掠夺性销售行为的影响。它体现了确保公平交易并为那些可能感到被迫签订长期合同的人提供补救措施的承诺。公义和怜悯的原则要求有这样的保护措施，以确保商业行为维护个人的尊严和福祉。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Unvaccinated children, elderly face much higher risk of major flu complications: official
title.zh: 未接种疫苗的儿童和老人面临更高的流感并发症风险：官员

summary.en: A Hong Kong health official has warned that unvaccinated children and elderly individuals are four to five times more likely to suffer severe complications or death from influenza compared to those who have been vaccinated. This warning comes as influenza cases in the city continue to rise, with infections increasing...
summary.zh: 香港卫生官员警告称，与接种疫苗者相比，未接种疫苗的儿童和老年人在感染流感后出现严重并发症或死亡的风险要高出四到五倍。此警告发布之际，香港的流感病例持续上升，自六月以来感染人数不断增加。

body.en: Unvaccinated children and elderly people are four to five times more likely to face serious complications or mortality from flu infections than those who receive vaccinations, a Hong Kong health official has warned, as influenza cases in the city continued to rise. Director of Health Ronald Lam Man-kin issued the warning on Saturday as he pointed out that Hong Kong’s influenza infections had been increasing since June. “Up until last week, the number of flu infections still remained at a high...
body.zh: 香港卫生官员警告说，随着该市流感病例持续上升，未接种疫苗的儿童和老年人因流感感染而面临严重并发症或死亡的可能性是接种疫苗的人的四到五倍。卫生署署长林文健周六发出警告，指出香港流感感染病例自六月以来不断增加。 “直到上周，流感感染人数仍然居高不下......

reflection.en: The news from Hong Kong serves as a stark reminder of vulnerability, particularly for the young and the elderly, when facing illness. James 5:14 calls us to pray for the sick, acknowledging their suffering and seeking divine intervention and comfort during times of physical weakness and potential danger.
reflection.zh: 香港传来的消息提醒我们，在面对疾病时，尤其是对儿童和老人而言，脆弱性是真实存在的。雅各书 5:14 呼吁我们为病人祷告，承认他们的痛苦，并在身体虚弱和潜在危险的时刻寻求神的介入和安慰。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Public urged to get jabs amid 'wave' of flu cases
title.zh: 流感病例激增，呼吁公众接种疫苗

summary.en: Hong Kong's Director of Health, Ronald Lam, urged the public to get vaccinated against the flu on Saturday. He noted that influenza infections have been increasing in a "wave-like pattern" since June, with Influenza A, particularly the H1 strain, being dominant. Public hospital visits for flu-like symptoms have surged...
summary.zh: 卫生署署长林文健周六呼吁市民接种流感疫苗。他指出，自六月以来，流感感染一直呈现“波浪式”上升的模式，其中甲型流感，特别是H1毒株占主导地位。与去年同期相比，公立医院流感样疾病求诊人次显著飙升。

body.en: Director of Health Ronald Lam urged the public to get inoculated against the flu on Saturday, saying influenza infections have been exhibiting a "wave-like pattern" increase since June. Speaking on a Commercial Radio programme, he said influenza A remains the primary virus type, with the dominant strain, H1, accounting for around 80 percent of infections and the H3 strain making up nearly 20 percent. Influenza B virus infections made up the rest. Lam said influenza infections were still high last week, with the rate of people seeking assistance at public hospitals surging to 0.83 per 10,000 patients, compared to 0.27 a year ago. Of the 19 cases of severe paediatric influenza infections this summer, half were aged five or below and three were not vaccinated. Lam urged parents to get their children inoculated as soon as possible, saying the risk of developing complications or severe conditions is more than five times higher for those who are not vaccinated. With the Seasonal Influenza Vaccination School Outreach programme set to launch on Thursday, he said the response has been very enthusiastic this year, with more than 99 percent of all schools having signed up. “We will complete vaccination for 80 schools by the end of September. For the same period last year, there were only five,” Lam said. “We also plan to complete the vaccination for more than 99 percent of participating schools by this season, meaning we hope all schools can get the jabs by mid-December.” The Department of Health, Lam said, has named the 14 schools that have not registered for the programme to encourage parents to turn to private-sector doctors enrolled in the government's vaccination subsidy scheme. These schools, he stressed, chose not to participate in the outreach programme due to various reasons, such as administrative arrangements. Edited by Robert Kemp
body.zh: 卫生署署长林中基周六呼吁公众接种流感疫苗，并表示自六月以来，流感感染呈“波浪式”增长。他在商业广播节目中表示，甲型流感仍然是主要病毒类型，主要毒株 H1 约占感染病例的 80%，H3 毒株约占感染病例的 20%。其余的是乙型流感病毒感染。林郑月娥表示，上周流感感染人数仍然很高，到公立医院寻求帮助的人数飙升至每万名患者0.83人，而一年前为每万名患者0.27人。今年夏季出现的19宗严重小儿流感感染个案中，一半为五岁或以下，其中三人没有接种疫苗。林郑月娥敦促家长尽快让孩子接种疫苗，并表示未接种疫苗的人出现并发症或严重疾病的风险要高出五倍多。他表示，季节性流感疫苗学校外展计划将于周四启动，今年的反应非常热烈，超过 99% 的学校已报名。 “我们将在9月底前完成80所学校的疫苗接种工作。去年同期，只有五所学校，”林说。 “我们还计划在本季度之前完成 99% 以上参与学校的疫苗接种，这意味着我们希望所有学校都能在 12 月中旬之前接种疫苗。”林郑月娥表示，卫生署已点名未登记参加该计划的 14 所学校，以鼓励家长向参加政府疫苗接种补贴计划的私营医生寻求帮助。他强调，这些学校由于行政安排等各种原因选择不参加外展计划。罗伯特·坎普编辑

reflection.en: As influenza cases surge, the call for vaccination and the strain on public hospitals underscore the vulnerability of our communities to widespread illness. In times of sickness, James 5:14 reminds us to pray for the afflicted and seek care, reflecting a communal responsibility for well-being.
reflection.zh: 随着流感病例激增，呼吁接种疫苗以及公立医院的压力凸显了我们社区在面对广泛疾病时的脆弱性。在疾病流行之时，《雅各书》5章14节提醒我们要为病人祷告并寻求医治，这反映了我们对社区福祉的共同责任。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Macau to hold closed-door trial in first national security case against democrat
title.zh: 澳门将在首次国家安全案中对民主派人士进行不公开审判

summary.en: Macau is set to hold its first national security trial next week behind closed doors for a former pro-democracy lawmaker accused of "subversion." This follows an expansion of national security laws in May 2023 and a new bill allowing closed-door hearings in such cases, raising concerns among legal experts and rights...
summary.zh: 澳门法院周五表示，下周将就首起国家安全案件举行不公开审判，被告是一名被控“颠覆罪”的前亲民主议员。此前，中国这个博彩中心于2023年5月扩大了国家安全法的适用范围，并于今年早些时候通过了一项新法案，允许法官在国家安全案件中进行不公开审理。律师和人权组织警告称，此规定可能会破坏政府部门的运作，并适用于“任何司法案件”。

body.en: Macau will hold its first national security trial behind closed doors next week, a court said on Friday, in a case against a former pro-democracy lawmaker charged with “subversion”. Former Macau lawmaker Au Kam San. File photo: Au Kam San, via Facebook. The Chinese casino hub expanded the scope of national security laws in May 2023, and a new bill passed earlier this year allows judges to hear national security cases behind closed doors. Lawyers and rights groups have warned that the rule could undermine the functioning of government departments and apply to “any judicial case”. Former Macau lawmaker Au Kam San in July 2025 became the first person to be arrested under the expanded law, with authorities alleging he had ties to foreign groups endangering China. The judge decided to “hold the trial behind closed doors in order to ensure that national security interests are not compromised”, a statement released by Macau’s final appeals court said. After Au’s arrest, details about the case remained scarce until this July, when judicial authorities in Macau confirmed that he would stand trial as a “principal offender” of subversion and other crimes. The court said the trial decision had been confirmed by Macau’s national security committee, following a request from the city’s public prosecutions office. The proceedings are set to begin September 16. Au, 69, is a primary school teacher who became one of Macau’s longest-serving pro-democracy legislators before deciding not to seek re-election in 2021. Authorities said that a court-appointed lawyer previously accepted by Au will continue to represent him. Macau flag. Photo: gavindeas, via Flickr. Michael Polak, a London-based barrister representing Au, said earlier this year that authorities having “appointed a state lawyer does not remedy the fundamental deficiencies in these proceedings which have all the appearances of a show trial”. “He is a Portuguese national and has been kept incommunicado for one year without access to his family or an independent lawyer,” Polak added. Au’s daughter Cherry said the family is not allowed to visit or communicate with him. “All we ask for is a fair trial, due process, and for his more than three decades of dedication to the people of Macau not to be erased or forgotten,” she said in a statement in July. Under Macau’s security law, subversion offences are subject to a prison term of up to 25 years.
body.zh: 一家法院周五表示，澳门将于下周举行首次国家安全审判，审理一名被控“颠覆国家政权”的前民主派议员的案件。前澳门议员区锦新。资料图：区金山，来自 Facebook。中国赌场中心于 2023 年 5 月扩大了国家安全法的范围，今年早些时候通过的一项新法案允许法官闭门审理国家安全案件。律师和人权组织警告说，该规则可能会损害政府部门的运作，并适用于“任何司法案件”。 2025 年 7 月，前澳门议员区锦新成为根据扩大后的法律被捕的第一人，当局指控他与危害中国的外国组织有联系。澳门终审法院发布的一份声明称，法官决定“闭门审理，以确保国家安全利益不受影响”。区被捕后，有关案件的细节一直很少，直到今年7月，澳门司法当局确认他将作为颠覆国家政权和其他罪行的“主犯”接受审判。法院表示，应澳门检察机关的要求，澳门国家安全委员会确认了审判决定。诉讼程序定于 9 月 16 日开始。区先生现年 69 岁，是一名小学教师，在决定不再寻求 2021 年连任之前，他成为澳门任职时间最长的民主派立法会议员之一。当局表示，区先生之前接受的一名法院指定的律师将继续代表他。澳门旗。照片：gavindeas，来自 Flickr。代表 Au 的驻伦敦大律师迈克尔·波拉克 (Michael Polak) 今年早些时候表示，当局“任命一名国家律师并没有弥补这些诉讼程序中的根本缺陷，这些诉讼程序看起来像是一场表演审判”。波拉克补充说：“他是葡萄牙国民，已被单独监禁一年，无法与家人或独立律师见面。” Au的女儿Cherry表示，家人不被允许探望或与他交流。她在七月的一份声明中表示：“我们所要求的只是公平审判、正当程序，以及他三十多年来对澳门人民的奉献不被抹去或遗忘。”根据澳门国安法，颠覆罪可被判处最高25年监禁。

reflection.en: The news from Macau, where a former lawmaker faces trial behind closed doors for alleged subversion, evokes Proverbs 28:15: "Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a poor people." The secrecy surrounding the trial raises concerns about justice and the potential for unchecked power to silence dissent, echoing the prophet's warning...
reflection.zh: 澳门前议员因涉嫌“颠覆罪”面临不公开审判的消息，令人联想起《箴言》28章15节：“恶劣的统治者统治贫苦的民众，如同咆哮的狮子或凶猛的熊。”审判的秘密性引发了对公正的担忧，以及不受制约的权力压制异议的可能性，这与先知对压迫性领导的警告不谋而合。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Beauty, gym contracts-tightening bill in first half
title.zh: 美容、健身合同收紧法案上半年提交

summary.en: Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau aims to submit proposed amendments to the Legislative Council in the first half of next year. These amendments will introduce a mandatory seven-day cooling-off period and a 14-day refund period for prepaid contracts sold by beauty parlours and fitness...
summary.zh: 商务及经济发展局局长丘应权希望在明年上半年向立法会提交拟议修订。这些修订将为美容院和健身中心销售的预付合同引入强制性的七天冷静期和十四天退款期。拟议的《商品说明条例》修订还将合同期限上限设为两年，并要求在签订合同后三个月内开始提供服务，合同金额门槛分别为三千港元、八千港元或一万五千港元。

body.en: Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau hopes to submit proposed amendments to the Legislative Council in the first half of next year, introducing a mandatory seven-day cooling-off period and a 14-day refund period for prepaid contracts sold by beauty parlours and fitness centres. Under the proposed amendments to the Trade Descriptions Ordinance, the new requirements would apply to contracts meeting one of three proposed thresholds: HK$3,000 or above, HK$8,000 or above, or HK$15,000 or above. The duration of beauty and fitness service contracts would be capped at two years, and operators would have to begin providing services within three months of signing a contract. Speaking on an RTHK radio programme on Saturday, Yau said the government was now collating views from the industries and the public following a consultation period that ended last month. "With regard to the cooling-off period, the fitness and beauty industries feel that it benefits everyone," he said. "They strongly support a seven-day cooling-off period and think seven days is sufficient. "This also follows the practices in many countries and economies internationally. We believe this is also feasible to implement." However, Yau said the industries have different views on the proposed thresholds. He said the final threshold may not be fixed at one of the proposed amounts and will be studied further. "Because fitness and beauty are actually two different industries, their contract amounts are very different," Yau said. "So now we are gathering views from the industries and will make adjustments. The main thing is that the amount must be able to help the industries do the business they are engaged in." Yau said authorities would study the issue in detail using median contract values and the nature of services, stressing that the government is seeking to balance protecting consumer rights with accommodating the industries' operational difficulties. Asked whether operators might split contracts to evade regulation, he stressed that the amended provisions would regulate contracts involving the same service. However, signing contracts for different services at the same time – such as, for example, one for facial and another for manicures with the same merchant – would not contravene the rules. After the study is completed, Yau hopes to submit the proposed legislative amendments to the Legislative Council for passage as soon as possible. Edited by Robert Kemp
body.zh: 商务及经济发展局局长邱腾华希望明年上半年向立法会提交修订建议，为美容院和健身中心出售的预付合约引入强制性7天冷静期和14天退款期。根据《商品说明条例》的拟议修订，新规定将适用于符合三个拟议门槛之一的合同：3,000 港元或以上、8,000 港元或以上、或 15,000 港元或以上。美容健身服务合同期限不得超过两年，经营者必须在签订合同后三个月内开始提供服务。丘周六在香港电台节目中表示，在上个月结束的咨询期之后，政府目前正在收集业界和公众的意见。 “对于冷静期，健身和美容行业认为这对每个人都有好处，”他说。 “他们强烈支持7天的冷静期，认为7天就足够了。”这也遵循了国际上许多国家和经济体的做法。 “我们认为这也是可行的。”不过，丘表示，业界对建议的门槛有不同的看法。他表示，最终的门槛可能不会固定在建议的金额之一，将进一步研究。“因为健身和美容实际上是两个不同的行业，他们的合同金额有很大不同。”丘说。“所以现在我们正在收集业界的意见，并会做出调整。”最主要的是，金额必须能够帮助行业开展业务。”邱腾华表示，当局会根据合同价值中位数和服务性质来详细研究问题，并强调政府正在寻求平衡保护消费者权益和适应行业运营困难。被问及运营商是否可能通过分割合同来逃避监管时，他强调，修订后的条款将规范涉及同一服务的合同。但是，同时签署不同服务的合同，例如一份面部护理合同和另一份美容服务合同与同一商户做美甲不会违反规定。研究完成后，丘希望尽快将拟议的法例修正案提交立法会通过。

reflection.en: The Hong Kong government is proposing new regulations to protect consumers from exploitative contracts in the beauty and fitness industries. This move reflects a commitment to ensuring fair dealings and safeguarding citizens from potential financial harm. It is a reminder that governing involves enacting laws that uphold justice and protect the vulnerable.
reflection.zh: 香港政府正提议制定新法规，以保护消费者免受美容和健身行业掠夺性合同的侵害。此举体现了维护公平交易和保障市民免受潜在经济损失的承诺。这提醒我们，治理涉及制定维护正义和保护弱势群体的法律。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: No medal pressure for SAR athletes: Law
title.zh: 港队亚运奖牌无压力：劳工处长

summary.en: The Minister for Sport, Rosanna Law, stated that she will not set a public medal target for the Hong Kong, China delegation for the upcoming Asian Games. She emphasized that athletes already face significant pressure and that her priority is for them to perform at their best and give their all, rather than focusing on...
summary.zh: 劳工及福利局局长罗致光表示，不会为香港代表团参加下周举行的亚运会设定公开奖牌目标。他强调运动员本身已承受巨大压力，他更关注的是运动员能发挥最佳水平，全力以赴，而不是奖牌预测。

body.en: The minister for sport Rosanna Law said she will not set a public medal target for the Hong Kong, China delegation for next week's Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, stressing that athletes already carry enough pressure. In an exclusive interview, Law told RTHK she deliberately avoids discussing medal predictions ahead of any major competition, preferring to let athletes concentrate on their performance. "It's not that I don't have a figure in mind – of course I do – but what matters most for athletes is that they perform at their own level – ideally even above their usual standard – that they give their all and never give up," she said. "We always say this is the SAR spirit we see in athletes from the Hong Kong, China team. That's what I look forward to." To back up the SAR squad with tangible action, the government has boosted its financial commitment for this year’s Asian Games. While the sports development fund historically covered around 90 percent of travel and participation costs for major international events, the city is now providing full funding for its 580-strong delegation. Law said the move would give athletes more opportunities to sharpen their skills through competition. "However hard you train in the Sports Institute, perhaps an opportunity to go abroad and compete with top tier athletes in the area would be even more effective," she said. "That's why we raised the ceiling for subsidy and we increased the frequency that they could participate in international events and that means an elevation of their resources as well." The Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism also pointed to a string of encouraging results from SAR athletes in the lead-up to the Games, including a silver medal for the men’s foil fencing team at the World Championships in Hong Kong. They also include a win and a runner-up finish in men’s badminton singles at the China Masters, and a gold medal for the men’s rugby sevens team at the Asian Rugby Sevens in Suzhou. Law highlighted strong performances in other disciplines as well, such as golf and swimming, and expressed confidence that athletes returning to the Asian Games – especially those who have recently achieved world-class results – would carry a certain degree of self-belief. Turning to team sports, Law said that a comprehensive review of support in this area would be conducted early next year, after the Asian Games. The review, she said, will examine several key areas, including development pathways, medical and sports science support, facility allocation, and coaching quality. Law cited the handball team’s historic semi-final run at the National Games as evidence that amateur teams are capable of delivering memorable performances, even without securing a medal. Currently, eight team sports receive government...
body.zh: 体育部长罗姗娜·罗表示，她不会为下周在爱知名古屋举行的亚运会的中国香港代表团设定公开奖牌目标，并强调运动员已经承受了足够的压力。罗在接受香港电台独家采访时表示，她在任何重大比赛前都刻意避免讨论奖牌预测，而是让运动员专注于自己的表现。 “这并不是说我心里没有一个数字——当然我有——但对运动员来说最重要的是他们在自己的水平上表现——最好甚至高于他们通常的标准——他们全力以赴，永不放弃，”她说。 “我们总是说，这就是我们在中国香港队运动员身上看到的特区精神。这就是我所期待的。”为了以实际行动支持特区队伍，政府加大了对今年亚运会的财政承诺。虽然体育发展基金历来承担重大国际赛事约 90% 的旅行和参与费用，但该市现在为其 580 人的代表团提供全额资金。劳表示，此举将为运动员提供更多机会通过比赛提高技能。 “无论你在体育学院训练多么努力，也许有机会出国与该地区的顶级运动员竞争会更有效，”她说。 “这就是为什么我们提高了补贴上限，并增加了他们参加国际活动的频率，这也意味着他们的资源得到了提升。”文化体育及旅游局局长还指出，特区运动员在奥运会筹备期间取得了一系列令人鼓舞的成绩，其中包括男子花剑击剑队在香港世锦赛上获得银牌。他们还包括在中国大师赛上获得男子羽毛球单打冠军和亚军，以及在苏州举行的亚洲七人制橄榄球赛上获得男子七人制橄榄球团体金牌。罗还强调了高尔夫和游泳等其他项目的强劲表现，并表示相信重返亚运会的运动员，尤其是那些最近取得世界级成绩的运动员，将具有一定程度的自信。谈到团队运动，罗表示，将于明年初亚运会后对这方面的支持进行全面审查。她说，审查将审查几个关键领域，包括发展途径、医疗和运动科学支持、设施分配和教练质量。罗引用手球队在全运会历史性半决赛的表现来证明，即使没有获得奖牌，业余球队也有能力打出令人难忘的表现。目前，八项团体运动项目受到政府...

reflection.en: Minister Rosanna Law wisely shields Hong Kong athletes from the pressure of public medal targets, encouraging them instead to focus on their personal best and the spirit of never giving up. This approach aligns with the biblical call to do all work heartily, as for Yahweh and not for men, finding dignity and purpose in dedicated effort itself, regardless of...
reflection.zh: 香港体育专员罗致光明智地让运动员免受公众奖牌目标的压力，鼓励他们专注于个人最佳表现和永不放弃的精神。这种做法与圣经中“无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的”的呼吁一致，在付出的努力本身中找到尊严和意义，而非仅仅关注结果。...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: 'Kai Tak Sports Park targets need pragmatic revamp'
title.zh: 启德体育园目标需要务实检讨

summary.en: Hong Kong's Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism, Rosanna Law, stated that the performance targets for the Kai Tak Sports Park, which is one and a half years old, require a pragmatic overhaul, despite its status as a top Asian venue. She noted that the park has significantly boosted Hong Kong's economy by hosting...
summary.zh: 文化体育及旅游局局长杨润雄表示，启用一年半的启德体育园“数十年前”制定的表现目标需要务实检讨，尽管该体育园是亚洲顶级的场地。她指出，启德体育园通过举办大型体育赛事，已成为香港经济的“游戏规则改变者”，推动了经济增长。她以去年举办的全运会为例，证明香港有能力举办一系列高水平的各项体育赛事。

body.en: Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law has said the one-and-a-half year old Kai Tak Sports Park's "decades-old" performance targets need a pragmatic overhaul, even though it is a top venue in Asia. Law told RTHK in an exclusive interview that Kai Tak Sports Park has been a game changer for Hong Kong's economy, driving growth through major sporting events. "The hosting of the National Games last year proves the point that Hong Kong is very capable of hosting a series of high-level competitions in different areas of sports," she said. "Thereafter, we actually focus our energy on hosting high-level major international events in single areas, such as badminton, volleyball, table tennis and fencing not to mention rugby sevens." But Law said the current performance indicators, which measure the venue's success by the number of "event days", were set years ago and fail to account for practical realities. "Even a football match isn't just about that one day. When preparing – laying turf and maintaining turf quality – the better the pitch quality, the more time you need for maintenance," she said. "These are things we need to consider when hosting sports events – we need to allocate that time. So in terms of meeting targets, we need to be pragmatic and up-to-date." But Law insisted the park has already delivered significant economic benefits. The summer Hong Kong Football Festival generated strong ticket sales and merchandise revenue, while pop-up stores and catering outlets at the park performed well. She also noted that international events have drawn tourists who stayed for multiple days, boosting hotels and dining across the city. Looking ahead, Law said Hong Kong will prioritise top-tier single-sport World Championships over bidding for the Olympics in the short-to-medium term. "Hosting the Olympics would certainly be a national act, a national decision," she said. "Given our current resource considerations and our short-to-medium-term sports development targets, focusing on top-level single-sport events and doing them well is a more important policy goal for us." Beyond sports, Law said the sports park has transformed Hong Kong's ability to attract global superstar concerts. "In the past, many friends might have said we were at a disadvantage in attracting superstar acts. But since Kai Tak Sports Park opened, we've seen that superstar acts are really interested in Hong Kong – many have already succeeded, and more will come," she said. Ultimately, Law said there is always room for improvement for the sports park. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 文化体育及旅游局局长罗姗娜表示，虽然启德体育公园是亚洲顶级场地，但已有一年半历史的启德体育公园“数十年历史”的绩效目标需要务实的改革。罗先生在接受香港电台独家专访时表示，启德体育园已改变香港经济的游戏规则，通过大型体育赛事推动经济增长。她说：“去年举办全运会证明香港有能力举办一系列不同体育领域的高水平比赛。” “此后，我们实际上把精力集中在举办单一领域的高水平重大国际赛事上，比如羽毛球、排球、乒乓球、击剑，更不用说七人制橄榄球了。”但劳表示，目前的绩效指标是多年前制定的，通过“活动天数”来衡量场馆的成功，未能考虑到实际情况。 “即使是一场足球比赛也不仅仅是有一天的事情。在准备时——铺设草坪和保持草坪质量——场地质量越好，维护所需的时间就越多，”她说。 “这些都是我们在举办体育赛事时需要考虑的事情——我们需要分配时间。因此，在实现目标方面，我们需要务实并与时俱进。”但劳坚称该园区已经带来了显着的经济效益。夏季香港足球节带来强劲的门票销售及商品收入，公园内的快闪店及餐饮店亦表现不俗。她还指出，国际活动吸引了游客停留多日，促进了全市酒店和餐饮业的发展。展望未来，罗先生表示，在中短期内，香港将优先考虑举办顶级单项世界锦标赛，而不是申办奥运会。 “举办奥运会肯定是一项国家行为、一项国家决定，”她说。 “从我们目前的资源考虑和中短期体育发展目标来看，聚焦并办好顶级单项赛事是我们更重要的政策目标。”除了体育之外，罗说，体育公园还改变了香港吸引全球巨星音乐会的能力。她说：“以前，很多朋友可能会说我们在吸引巨星方面处于劣势。但自从启德体育公园开业以来，我们发现巨星对香港确实很感兴趣，很多人已经成功了，而且还会有更多。”最后，劳表示，体育公园总有改进的空间。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The Kai Tak Sports Park, a significant investment for Hong Kong, is undergoing a review of its performance targets. This process underscores the need for careful planning and adaptation in large-scale projects. Committing our endeavors, whether in sports infrastructure or personal pursuits, to divine guidance can lead to more effective and fruitful outcomes.
reflection.zh: 启德体育园是香港的一项重要投资，目前正对其表现目标进行检讨。这一过程凸显了在大型项目中进行审慎规划和适应性调整的必要性。将我们的努力，无论是体育基础设施还是个人追求，都交托给神的指引，可以带来更有效和硕果累累的结果。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Yu Zidi: China’s fearless swimming prodigy, 13, with Olympics in her sights
title.zh: 余梓迪：中国无畏的游泳天才，13岁，奥运在望

summary.en: Yu Zidi made history last year aged 12 when she became the youngest-ever medallist at the swimming world championships. Now a teenager, she headlines China’s bid for Asian Games domination and has Olympic glory in her sights. The 13-year-old school girl with a pixie hair cut...
summary.zh: 余梓迪去年12岁时创造了历史，成为游泳世锦赛最年轻的奖牌得主。如今已是青少年，她领衔中国队争夺亚运会霸主地位，并以奥运荣耀为目标。这位13岁的留着精灵短发的在校女生……

body.en: Yu Zidi made history last year aged 12 when she became the youngest-ever medallist at the swimming world championships. Now a teenager, she headlines China’s bid for Asian Games domination and has Olympic glory in her sights. China’s swimmer Yu Zidi prepares for the final of the women’s 200m butterfly swimming event during the 2025 World Aquatics Championships in Singapore on July 31, 2025. Photo: Oli Scarff/AFP. The 13-year-old school girl with a pixie hair cut stunned the sporting world last year with a series of eye-popping times. At the 2025 World Aquatics Championships in Singapore she helped China reach the 4x200m women’s freestyle relay final. She did not swim in the final but China came third, earning Yu a historic bronze for swimming in the heats. Yu just missed out on medals in the 200m and 400m individual medley events and the 200m butterfly, coming fourth in all three races. In November at China’s National Games, having just turned 13, she clocked a blistering 2:07.41 in the women’s 200m medley for what was then an Asian record. While training with the China team in Beijing, she told local media this month she was “excited” for her Asian Games debut. “Train well, don’t slack off. Demonstrate the level of your training and work hard to break past yourself,” she said, according to state news agency Xinhua. The Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan open on September 19. Pressure ‘like a stone’ A coach, Ha Sinan, once described Yu with a Chinese saying that translates as “a newborn calf fearless of tigers”. But the teenager has spoken of struggling to deal with the heavy load placed on her. Yu grew up in the city of Baoding, about 150 kilometres (90 miles) south of Beijing. She started swimming aged six and since then has juggled schoolwork with training. “Being in class all day and still having to train was really tiring,” she said in January. “Sometimes I was so tired I could fall asleep even while eating,” she said at an event celebrating Hebei province’s National Games wins. Yu said she “never considered quitting” and always dreamed of being a national champion. But during the tune-up to last year’s National Games she said the pressure of wanting to win the 400m medley nearly became too much. “It was like a big stone that weighed on me and made it hard to breathe,” she said. Yu eventually told her coach she wanted to do anything other than train. Her coach told her to persevere and “believe in yourself”, she said. Yu went on to win four medals at the National Games. Some in the swimming world have questioned the mental and physical impact of high-level training and competing on Yu...
body.zh: 去年，12岁的于紫迪创造了历史，成为游泳世锦赛上最年轻的奖牌获得者。如今，十几岁的她成为中国争夺亚运会冠军的头条新闻，并瞄准了奥运会的荣耀。 2025 年 7 月 31 日，在新加坡举行的 2025 年世界游泳锦标赛上，中国游泳运动员于子迪正在备战女子 200 米蝶泳决赛。照片：Oli Scarff/法新社。这位留着精灵发型的 13 岁女学生去年以一系列令人瞠目结舌的成绩震惊了体育界。在2025年新加坡世界游泳锦标赛上，她帮助中国队进入了女子4x200米自由泳接力决赛。她没有参加决赛，但中国队获得了第三名，为余在预赛中获得历史性的铜牌。于刚在200米和400米个人混合泳以及200米蝶泳项目中错失奖牌，在所有三场比赛中均获得第四名。 11月的中国全运会上，刚满13岁的她在女子200米混合泳中取得了惊人的2分07.41秒的成绩，创造了当时的亚洲纪录。在北京与中国队一起训练时，她本月对当地媒体表示，她对自己的亚运首秀感到“兴奋”。据官方通讯社新华社报道，她说：“好好训练，不要懈怠。展示你的训练水平，努力突破自己。”日本爱知名古屋亚运会将于9月19日开幕。压力“如石” 教练哈斯南曾用中国的一句话来形容于玉，“初生牛犊不怕虎”。但这位少女表示，她正在努力应对所承受的沉重负担。于在北京以南约 150 公里（90 英里）的保定市长大。她六岁开始游泳，从那时起她就兼顾学业和训练。 “一整天都在课堂上，而且还要训练，真的很累，”她在一月份说道。 “有时我太累了，连吃饭的时候都能睡着，”她在庆祝河北省全运会胜利的活动中说道。于说她“从未考虑过放弃”，一直梦想着成为全国冠军。但在去年全运会的备战期间，她表示想要赢得 4 亿米混合泳冠军的压力几乎变得太大了。 “这就像一块大石头压在我身上，让我呼吸困难，”她说。于最终告诉她的教练，除了训练之外，她想做任何事情。她说，她的教练告诉她要坚持下去并“相信自己”。于随后在全运会上赢得了四枚奖牌。游泳界的一些人质疑高水平训练和比赛对运动员心理和身体的影响……

reflection.en: At just 13, Yu Zidi is already making waves, aiming for the highest levels of competitive swimming. Her journey embodies the dedication and discipline required to pursue athletic excellence, reminding us of the Apostle Paul's exhortation to run with all our might for the prize that is imperishable. May her youthful ambition inspire perseverance in all...
reflection.zh: 年仅13岁的余梓迪已在泳坛掀起波澜，朝着竞技游泳的最高殿堂迈进。她的旅程体现了追求卓越体育成就所需的奉献和纪律，提醒我们使徒保罗的劝勉：要竭力奔跑，去赢得那永不朽坏的冠冕。 愿她年轻的志向激励我们在所有事业中坚持不懈，无论是在体育、学业还是信仰上，尽我们所能，因为我们知道真正的奖赏超越世俗的赞誉。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: Animal NGO urges Hongkongers to shun gov’t-backed equestrian show Cavalluna
title.zh: 动物非营利组织敦促香港人抵制政府支持的马术表演Cavalluna

summary.en: People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals Asia (PETA) has urged Hongkongers to boycott the live equestrian theatrical show Cavalluna at the Kai Tak Arena, citing allegations of animal cruelty. The show, which features 54 horses and runs until Sunday, is hosted by the Hong Kong Jockey Club.
summary.zh: 亚洲善待动物组织（PETA）已敦促香港市民抵制在启德体育馆举行的现场马术表演Cavalluna，理由是涉及虐待动物的指控。该表演有54匹马参与，将持续至周日，并由香港赛马会主办。

body.en: People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals Asia (PETA) has urged Hongkongers to shun a live equestrian theatrical show at the Kai Tak Arena, citing animal cruelty allegations. Cavalluna – Gate to the Otherworld. Photo: Cavalluna – Gate to the Otherworld. Cavalluna – Gate to the Otherworld debuted on Tuesday and runs until Sunday, with the Hong Kong Jockey Club as the main host and event partner. The immersive show from Europe involves 54 horses, stunts, dancing and large sets. In a statement on Thursday, a PETA Asia spokesperson said: “Horses are sensitive, intelligent animals who feel fear and pain—not entertainment props to be trotted out under blinding lights and fireworks for a paying crowd.” Underprivileged, youth and elderly groups attend the Cavalluna dress rehearsal with assistance from the Hong Kong Jockey Club. Photo: Hong Kong Jockey Club. “A PETA Germany investigation into Cavalluna documented horses being forced into the painful, welfare-violating ‘rollkur’ head-and-neck position and driven with whip-cracks into frightening tricks involving fire and light effects,” they added. The NGO called on the public to reject “spectacles that exploit animals and to choose only animal-free entertainment.” PETA Germany footage appearing to show a Cavalluna horse adopting the “rollkur” head-and-neck position. Photo: PETA Germany. PETA Germany released video clips last year appearing to show Cavalluna horses repeatedly enduring painful overstretching of the neck, restrictions in sight and breathing, and involvement in tricks involving fire and light. The whistle-blower footage was submitted to the Berlin Public Prosecutor’s Office as part of a criminal complaint alleging animal welfare violations. Horses ‘part of the family’ Cavalluna previously responded to PETA Germany on its website, saying animal welfare is its highest priority: “You cannot force a horse to perform gracefully and willingly — not with coercion, food deprivation, or any other methods that violate animal welfare. It is simply impossible to present a horse in liberty work or any other riding discipline if the animal is not willing to cooperate… If a horse were scared or suffering, even a layperson could easily see it in its body language and expression.” Cavalluna – Gate to the Otherworld. Photo: Hong Kong Jockey Club. They said that animal welfare representatives and independent official veterinarians examine all animals, tents, transport vehicles and riding gear worldwide, adding that Cavalluna horses are stallions which “enjoy presenting themselves.” In a response on Friday to HKFP, Cavalluna said “Short video clips or photographs can never...
body.zh: 亚洲善待动物组织（PETA）以虐待动物指控为由，敦促香港人不要在启德体育馆观看现场马术表演。卡瓦卢纳——通往另一个世界的大门。照片：卡瓦卢纳——通往另一个世界的大门。卡瓦卢纳——通往异世界之门于周二首次亮相，一直持续到周日，由香港赛马会作为主要主办方和活动合作伙伴。来自欧洲的沉浸式表演涉及 54 匹马、特技、舞蹈和大型布景。在周四的一份声明中，亚洲善待动物组织的一位发言人表示：“马是敏感、聪明的动物，它们能感受到恐惧和痛苦，而不是在炫目的灯光和烟花下为付费人群展示的娱乐道具。”弱势群体、青少年和长者团体在香港赛马会的协助下参加卡瓦卢纳彩排。照片：香港赛马会。他们补充说：“善待动物组织德国对卡瓦卢纳的一项调查记录了马匹被迫做出痛苦的、违反福利的‘rollkur’头颈姿势，并用鞭子抽打，进行涉及火焰和灯光效果的可怕技巧。”该非政府组织呼吁公众拒绝“剥削动物的景象，只选择无动物的娱乐活动”。德国善待动物组织的镜头显示，一匹卡瓦卢纳马采用“rollkur”头颈姿势。照片：善待动物组织德国。德国善待动物组织去年发布的视频片段似乎显示卡瓦卢纳马反复忍受颈部过度拉伸的痛苦、视力和呼吸的限制以及涉及火和光的技巧。举报人的视频已作为指控侵犯动物福利的刑事诉讼的一部分提交给柏林检察官办公室。马匹是“家庭的一部分”，卡瓦卢纳此前在其网站上对德国善待动物组织做出回应，称动物福利是其最优先考虑的事项：“你不能强迫马优雅而自愿地表现——不能通过胁迫、剥夺食物或任何其他侵犯动物福利的方法。如果动物不愿意合作，那么根本不可能让马进行自由工作或任何其他骑术纪律……如果一匹马感到害怕或痛苦，即使是外行人也可以很容易地从它的肢体语言和表情中看出这一点。”卡瓦卢纳——通往另一个世界的大门。照片：香港赛马会。他们说，动物福利代表和独立的官方兽医检查了世界各地的所有动物、帐篷、运输车辆和骑行装备，并补充说卡瓦卢纳马是“喜欢展示自己”的种马。卡瓦卢纳在周五对 HKFP 的回应中表示：“短视频片段或照片永远无法......

reflection.en: The PETA Asia spokesperson's statement that "Horses are sensitive, intelligent animals who feel fear and pain—not entertainment props" speaks to the vulnerability of creatures who cannot advocate for themselves. This echoes the call in Proverbs to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for all their rights." The plea to shun the Cavalluna show...
reflection.zh: 亚洲善待动物组织发言人称“马匹是敏感、聪明的动物，它们会感到恐惧和痛苦——而不是被当作娱乐道具”，这呼应了《箴言》中“你们要为不能说话的辩护，为所有孤苦无依的人伸张正义”的呼吁。抵制Cavalluna表演的呼吁，正是为那些可能默默忍受痛苦的动物发声的倡导行为。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘People will be shocked and angry’: Relatives, friends of jailed Tiananmen activists decry ‘unjust’ sentences
title.zh: “人们会感到震惊和愤怒”：被监禁的“六四”活动人士的亲友谴责“不公正”的判决

summary.en: Relatives of three Tiananmen vigil activists sentenced on Friday for inciting subversion have decried their years-long prison terms as “totally unjust,” and have said that two of the defendants will appeal. Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, leaders of the now-defunct Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic...
summary.zh: 周五，三名参与“六四”守夜活动的活动人士因煽动颠覆国家政权罪被判处多年监禁，他们的亲属对此判决表示“完全不公正”，并称其中两人将提出上诉。已解散的“香港市民支援爱国民主运动联合会”的领导人李卓人被判处七年监禁，周汉鼎被判处七年零三个月监禁。该联盟的另一位领导人何俊仁是三人中唯一认罪的人，被判处十二个月监禁。

body.en: Relatives of three Tiananmen vigil activists sentenced on Friday for inciting subversion have decried their years-long prison terms as “totally unjust,” and have said that two of the defendants will appeal. Elizabeth Tang (second from left), mother of Chow (middle) and Lau Ka-yee (first from right) met the press after sentences on September 11, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, leaders of the now-defunct Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, were handed jail terms of seven years and seven years and three months, respectively. Fellow Alliance leader Albert Ho, the only one of the trio to plead guilty, received a sentence of five years and two months. The Alliance, which was also convicted and fined HK$1.5 million, held annual vigils to remember China’s 1989 Tiananmen crackdown. Elizabeth Tang outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on Friday, September 11, 2026, ahead of the sentencing of Tiananmen vigil activists Chow Hang-tung, Albert Ho, and her husband Lee Cheuk-yan. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Lee’s wife, Elizabeth Tang, told reporters outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building that the sentence, delivered by a panel of designated national security judges, was “unacceptable.” “It’s a sad day for me as his wife,” Tang said in Cantonese. “I cannot imagine that he has to spend another three years in jail.” “People will be shocked and angry,” she added. “Millions of people were there in Victoria Park [for the vigil].” Family members and friends of Tiananmen vigil activists meet the press on September 11, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Tang said Chow and Lee intend to launch an appeal against their convictions and sentences. June 4th memories ‘reopened’ Chow Hang-tung’s mother, who declined to give her name to press, said on Friday that her daughter was proud to represent herself in court. “She once said: ‘It feels great, I can finally take off my barrister’s robe and speak the truth freely on my own behalf’,” Chow’s mother recalled her daughter saying. Mother of Chow Hang-tung meets the press on September 11, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP, “I don’t know whether I should thank those who dragged her to the dock,” Chow’s mother said. “Thanks to them, the memories of June 4th were reopened. Thanks to them, the truth of June 4th and everything that has happened in Hong Kong over these years has been entered into Hong Kong court records.” The Tiananmen crackdown occurred on June 4, 1989, ending months of student-led demonstrations in China. It is estimated that hundreds, perhaps thousands, died when the People’s...
body.zh: 周五因煽动颠覆罪被判刑的三名天安门守夜活动人士的亲属谴责他们长达数年的监禁“完全不公正”，并表示其中两名被告将上诉。 2026 年 9 月 11 日，周先生（中）和刘嘉儿（右一）的母亲邓丽君（左二）在宣判后会见媒体。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。现已解散的香港爱国民主运动联盟领导人李卓人和周恒东分别被判处七年和七年零三个月徒刑。联盟领导人何俊仁是三人中唯一认罪的人，被判处五年零两个月的徒刑。该联盟也被定罪并被罚款 150 万港元，该联盟每年都会举行守夜活动，以纪念中国 1989 年的天安门镇压。 2026 年 9 月 11 日星期五，伊丽莎白·唐在西九龙法院大楼外，天安门守夜活动人士周恒东、何俊仁和她的丈夫李卓人即将被判刑。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。李的妻子伊丽莎白·唐(Elizabeth Tang)在西九龙法院大楼外告诉记者，由指定的国家安全法官组成的小组做出的判决“令人无法接受”。 “作为他的妻子，这对我来说是悲伤的一天，”唐用广东话说道。 “我无法想象他还要在监狱里再呆三年。” “人们会感到震惊和愤怒，”她补充道。 “数百万人在维多利亚公园[守夜]。”天安门守夜活动人士的家人和朋友于 2026 年 9 月 11 日与媒体会面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。唐说，周和李打算对他们的定罪和判刑提出上诉。 6 月 4 日的记忆“重新开启”周恒东的母亲拒绝向媒体透露姓名，她周五表示，她的女儿很自豪能够在法庭上代表自己。 “她曾经说过：‘感觉太棒了，我终于可以脱掉律师的袍子，代表我自己自由地说出真相了’，”周妈妈回忆女儿说。周恒东的母亲于 2026 年 9 月 11 日会见媒体。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP，“我不知道是否应该感谢那些把她拖到被告席上的人，”周恒东的母亲说。 “感谢他们，重新开​​启了6月4日的记忆。感谢他们，6月4日的真相以及这些年香港发生的一切都被载入了香港法庭记录。”天安门镇压发生于 1989 年 6 月 4 日，结束了中国学生领导的数月示威活动。据估计，当人民...

reflection.en: The families of Lee Cheuk-yan, Chow Hang-tung, and Albert Ho are calling their sentences “totally unjust.” This echoes the ancient cry for justice, a fundamental theme in scripture. May Yahweh hear their plea and may righteousness prevail, flowing like a mighty river through the courts and into society.
reflection.zh: 李卓人、周汉鼎和何俊仁的家属称他们的判决“完全不公正”。这呼应了古老的对公义的呼求，这是圣经中的一个基本主题。愿雅伟垂听他们的祈求，愿公义如大河奔腾，流淌在法庭和社会之中。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of one count of deterring reporter Selina Cheng from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有一项阻止记者郑丽莎担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。此案引发了对该市新闻自由的担忧，郑女士在2024年被任命为香港记协主席数周后被公司以重组为由解雇。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明謀殺》評論——香港外星人綁架和真實犯罪網紅的戲謔模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes the limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a playfully affectionate send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe...
summary.zh: 在一部低成本的喜劇冒險片中，兒時的朋友聲稱目睹了一名學生的失蹤，該片挑戰了敘事的極限。由郭嘉曦和李晉傑執導，規模不大但結構精巧的這部喜劇，是對真實犯罪愛好者和準網紅們的戲謔模仿，充滿了喜愛而非惡意。故事圍繞一個虛構的、已成為香港熱議話題的25年前的案件展開。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……真的是这样吗？影片以一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一种竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一种写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This Hong Kong comedy playfully explores how easily people can become engrossed in sensationalized stories, whether about alien abductions or true crime. The film's affectionate parody reminds us to approach narratives with discernment, questioning what truly holds our attention and why. Proverbs 14:15 warns, "The simple believe whatever is said, but the...
reflection.zh: 這部香港喜劇以戲謔的方式探討了人們如何輕易地沉迷於聳人聽聞的故事，無論是關於外星人綁架還是真實犯罪。電影充滿愛意的模仿提醒我們，要帶著分辨力來對待敘事，質疑什麼真正吸引了我們的注意力，以及為什麼。箴言14:15警告說：「單純的人凡話都信；智慧的人謹慎自己的腳步。」這呼籲我們對所消費和分享的故事，特別是那些吸引我們想像力的故事，要深思熟慮。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

title.zh: 香港民主派活动家黄之锋承认一项新的国家安全案件

The charge, under the national security law, carries a potential life sentence. Prosecutors allege Wong worked with another activist to encourage foreign powers to impose...
summary.zh: 香港著名民主派活动家黄之锋承认了寻求外国制裁中国的共谋罪名。这项国家安全法指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检方指控黄之锋与另一名活动家合作，鼓励外国势力实施制裁。

Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong's guilty plea in a national security case brings to mind the ancient dilemma of conscience versus state authority. When laws compel actions that conflict with deeply held moral or religious convictions, believers face a profound choice. The apostles' response, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless principle for...
reflection.zh: 黄之锋在国安案件中认罪，让人联想到良心与国家权威之间的古老困境。当法律迫使人们采取违背其坚定道德或宗教信念的行为时，信徒们面临着一个深刻的选择。使徒们的回应‘我们必须听从神，过于听从人’，为应对此类冲突提供了永恒的原则。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。
